0g: 0G is a modular, Ethereum-compatible layer-1 blockchain built for decentralized AI. It combines a smart-contract chain, cheap fast data storage, a data-availability layer and AI compute; the 0G token pays for services and staking.
1inch: 1inch (1INCH) is a DeFi aggregator of decentralized exchanges, founded in 2019 by Sergej Kunz and Anton Bukov. It looks for the best exchange rate by splitting a trade across many exchanges on different networks; the 1INCH token is used to govern the protocol.
1win: 1win Token (1WIN) is a Solana token launched in 2026 by 1win, an online gambling platform founded in 2016 that offers sports betting, casino games, poker and esports betting. The token serves as a gaming currency on the platform, with a fixed supply and burns.
2z: DoubleZero (2Z) is a protocol for a global fiber-optic network that moves data quickly between blockchain validators, above all on Solana, and trading systems. Independent fiber owners contribute links, and 2Z is the token that connects network users with these infrastructure providers.
4: The token 4 is a meme coin on BNB Chain. Like most meme coins, it is not backed by a business or assets, and its price is driven mainly by community attention and trading.
9bit: 9BIT is the token of The9bit, a gaming platform with an AI game generator that gathers PC, mobile and browser games in one hub. Blockchain records ownership of in-game items, and 9BIT is used for rewards and payments.
a: Agilent Technologies is a US company from Santa Clara, California, spun off from Hewlett-Packard in 1999. It makes chromatographs, mass spectrometers, lab instruments and reagents for pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, food and chemicals.
a-token: Vaulta (A) is the layer-1 network that the EOS blockchain was renamed to in 2025, refocused on Web3 banking. It combines fast transactions with infrastructure for payments, Bitcoin yield via exSat and tokenized assets; EOS tokens were swapped for A.
a8: Ancient8 is a gaming-focused Ethereum layer 2 blockchain backed by funds such as Dragonfly, Pantera and Coinbase Ventures. It gives Web3 games infrastructure and distribution channels; A8 is the network's token.
aapl: Apple is a US technology company based in Cupertino, California, founded in 1976 by Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak. It makes the iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch and AirPods and earns from services such as the App Store, iCloud and Apple Music.
aapl-token: Apple • Robinhood Token is a tokenized version of Apple shares issued by Robinhood for its customers in the European Union. It follows the price of the US-listed stock and can be traded around the clock on a blockchain.
aave: Aave is one of the largest decentralized lending protocols, where users lend and borrow crypto without intermediaries. It runs on Ethereum and many other networks; the AAVE token is used for governance and to backstop the protocol. Its founder is Stani Kulechov.
abbn: ABB is a Swiss-Swedish engineering company based in Zurich, formed in 1988 by merging Sweden's ASEA and Switzerland's Brown Boveri. It makes electrification equipment, electric motors, industrial automation and EV charging stations.
abbv: AbbVie is an American biopharmaceutical company based in North Chicago, Illinois, spun off from Abbott Laboratories in 2013. It is known for the immunology drugs Humira, Skyrizi and Rinvoq and, since buying Allergan, also for Botox.
abel: Abelian (ABEL) is a layer-1 blockchain designed to be both quantum-resistant and privacy-preserving. Its cryptography aims to withstand attacks from future quantum computers, and ABEL can be used with full privacy, accountable privacy or at a pseudonymous level.
abev3: Ambev is Latin America's largest brewer, based in São Paulo, Brazil, and controlled by the Belgian group AB InBev. It makes beers such as Brahma, Skol and Antarctica, distributes global brands like Budweiser, Stella Artois and Corona, and produces the soft drink Guaraná Antarctica and PepsiCo drinks in Brazil.
abey: ABEYCHAIN (ABEY) is a layered, programmable blockchain designed for high transaction volumes that also offers decentralized data storage. The ABEY token is used to pay fees and run applications on the network.
abn: ABN AMRO is one of the largest banks in the Netherlands, based in Amsterdam. It serves individuals, wealthy clients and businesses with current accounts, mortgages, savings, private banking and corporate lending, mostly in the Netherlands and northwest Europe; it was nationalized during the 2008 financial crisis and the Dutch state remains a major shareholder.
abnb: Airbnb is a US short-term rental platform based in San Francisco, founded in 2008. Hosts rent out apartments, houses and rooms to travellers and also offer experiences and services in more than 220 countries and regions.
abt: Abbott Laboratories is an American healthcare company based in Illinois, founded in 1888. It makes medical devices (including FreeStyle Libre glucose monitors), diagnostic tests, Similac infant formula and Ensure nutrition drinks, and generic medicines.
abt-token: ArcBlock is a blockchain platform for building and deploying decentralized applications, launched in 2018. It gives developers ready-made tools and services for dApps and decentralized identity; ABT is the ecosystem's token.
abx: Barrick Mining (formerly Barrick Gold) is one of the world's largest gold miners, founded in 1983 in Toronto. It mines gold and copper at operations in North and South America, Africa and Asia.
ac-mx: Arca Continental is a Mexican company from Monterrey and one of the world's largest Coca-Cola bottlers. It produces and distributes Coca-Cola drinks in northern Mexico, Peru, Ecuador, Argentina and the southwestern United States, and also makes Bokados snacks.
aca: Crédit Agricole is a French banking group that grew out of a network of regional cooperative banks for farmers. It offers retail and corporate banking, insurance and asset management through Amundi, Europe's largest asset manager.
ace: Fusionist is a AAA-style blockchain game about space mech battles, built on the Unity engine. Players collect and upgrade combat robots and fight in strategy modes; ACE is the game token for the in-game economy and governance.
acgl: Arch Capital Group is a Bermuda-based insurance group founded in 1995. It writes specialty insurance, reinsurance (insurance for insurers) and mortgage insurance in the United States, Europe and other regions.
acm-token: AC Milan Fan Token (ACM) is the official fan token of AC Milan, the Italian football club, launched through Socios.com on the Chiliz Chain. Holders vote in club polls and can win rewards and fan experiences.
acn: Accenture is a global consulting and IT services company legally domiciled in Dublin, Ireland. It helps businesses and governments with digital transformation, cloud, cybersecurity and AI adoption, and runs entire business processes as an outsourcer.
acn-token: AITECH Cloud Network (ACN) is an AI infrastructure platform offering rented GPU compute (NVIDIA H200, H100 and others) for training and running models, plus tools to build and manage autonomous AI agents. ACN is its payment token on Ethereum.
acs: ACS is one of the world's largest construction groups, based in Madrid and chaired by Florentino Pérez. Through Germany's Hochtief and Australia's CIMIC it builds roads, tunnels, railways, data centres and other infrastructure in Europe, the US and Australia.
acs-token: Access Protocol is a Solana-based system for paying creators without classic subscriptions. Readers lock (stake) ACS tokens in a creator's pool to unlock their content, and both the reader and the creator earn ACS rewards.
act: Act I: The AI Prophecy (ACT) is a Solana memecoin launched in 2024, tied to Act I, a community experiment in which several AI models chat with each other and with people in open group conversations. It has no utility beyond its community.
acu: Acurast (ACU) is a decentralized compute network that uses ordinary smartphones instead of data centers. Phone owners contribute processing power to run apps, APIs and AI models and earn rewards, while developers get verifiable confidential computing.
acwa-power: ACWA Power is a Saudi energy company from Riyadh, founded in 2004. It builds and operates power plants and water desalination plants in Saudi Arabia, the Middle East, Africa and Asia, with a focus on solar, wind and green hydrogen.
acx: Across Protocol (ACX) is a bridge for moving assets quickly between Ethereum and layer-2 networks, secured by UMA's optimistic oracle. Independent relayers complete transfers almost instantly, and ACX serves as the governance token.
ad: Ahold Delhaize is a Dutch-Belgian retail group from Zaandam, formed in 2016 by the merger of Ahold and Delhaize. It runs Albert Heijn supermarkets in the Netherlands, Delhaize in Belgium and the Food Lion and Stop & Shop chains in the US, plus the online store bol.
ada: Cardano is a smart-contract blockchain developed on the basis of peer-reviewed academic research. It was founded by Ethereum co-founder Charles Hoskinson, runs on the Ouroboros proof-of-stake protocol, and ADA is used for fees, staking and governance.
adanient: Adani Enterprises is the flagship company of India's Adani Group, founded by Gautam Adani and based in Ahmedabad. It acts as the group's incubator for new businesses, including airports, solar panel and green-hydrogen manufacturing, roads, data centers and mining, alongside its long-standing coal trading business.
adaniports: Adani Ports and SEZ is India's largest private port operator, based in Ahmedabad and part of the Adani Group. It runs Mundra port and other terminals in India and abroad, including Haifa, as well as logistics and special economic zones.
adbe: Adobe is a US software maker from San Jose, California, founded in 1982 by John Warnock and Charles Geschke. It created Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro and the PDF format, sells them by Creative Cloud subscription, and also offers marketing software for businesses.
adi: Analog Devices is an American maker of analog and mixed-signal chips based in Massachusetts, founded in 1965. Its chips convert real-world signals such as sound, temperature and motion into digital data and back, and are used in industry, cars, communications and medicine.
adi-token: ADI (ADI Chain) is an Ethereum layer-2 network from the Abu Dhabi-based ADI Foundation, aimed at government and enterprise infrastructure. Built on ZKsync's ZK Stack, it lets countries and companies run systems for payments, e-invoicing and registries.
adm: Archer Daniels Midland (ADM) is one of the world's largest agricultural processors, based in Chicago and founded in 1902. It buys, stores and ships grain and oilseeds and makes vegetable oils, flour, sweeteners, animal feed and food ingredients.
adm-token: ADAMANT Messenger (ADM) is the coin of ADAMANT, a decentralized blockchain messenger that needs no phone number or e-mail and stores encrypted messages on its own blockchain. ADM pays for sending messages and can be transferred in chats.
adp: ADP (Automatic Data Processing) is a US company from New Jersey, founded in 1949, and a leader in payroll services. It provides businesses with cloud tools for payroll, taxes, HR and benefits, and publishes a well-known monthly US employment report.
ads: Adidas is a German maker of sportswear, shoes and accessories from Herzogenaurach, founded in 1949 by Adi Dassler. It is known for its three stripes, the Superstar, Samba and Stan Smith sneakers and kits for national football teams and clubs.
ads-token: Adshares is a Polish blockchain project that runs a decentralized advertising network connecting publishers and advertisers directly, without a big ad-tech middleman. ADS is used to pay for ads and settle payments to publishers.
adsk: Autodesk is a US design software company from San Francisco, founded in 1982. It is best known for AutoCAD, and also makes Revit for architects, Fusion for engineers and Maya and 3ds Max for 3D animation in films and games.
advanc: Advanced Info Service (AIS) is Thailand's largest mobile operator, based in Bangkok and founded in 1986. It provides mobile and 5G service, AIS Fibre home internet and business services; major shareholders include Gulf and Singapore's Singtel.
advantest: Advantest is a Japanese company based in Tokyo and the world leader in semiconductor test equipment. Its testers check processors, AI graphics chips and memory before they are shipped to customers.
adx: heyAura is a personal AI agent for crypto investors that looks for yield opportunities, optimises a portfolio and claims airdrops automatically. It grew out of AdEx, one of the first blockchain advertising protocols, so the token kept the ADX ticker.
adyen: Adyen is a Dutch payments company from Amsterdam, founded in 2006. Its single platform lets large businesses such as Uber, Spotify and McDonald's accept online, in-app and in-store payments, combining the gateway, card acquiring and fraud protection.
aee: Ameren is an American utility from St. Louis, Missouri. Through its subsidiaries Ameren Missouri and Ameren Illinois it generates and delivers electricity and natural gas to millions of customers in Missouri and Illinois.
aem: Agnico Eagle Mines is a Canadian gold miner based in Toronto, founded in 1957 and one of the largest gold producers in the world. It runs mines in Canada (including Detour Lake and Canadian Malartic), Finland, Australia and Mexico.
aena: Aena is a Spanish airport operator, the world's largest by passenger traffic, headquartered in Madrid. It runs almost all of Spain's airports, including Madrid-Barajas and Barcelona-El Prat, as well as airports in Brazil and London Luton; the state holds a controlling stake.
aeon: AEON builds payment and settlement infrastructure for AI agents, so autonomous agents can pay each other and settle with the real world using protocols such as x402, ERC-8004 and MCP. It is backed by YZi Labs and IDG Capital.
aep: American Electric Power is one of the largest US power companies, based in Columbus, Ohio, and founded in 1906. It generates and delivers electricity to millions of customers in 11 states and owns the country's largest network of high-voltage transmission lines.
aero: Aero is a decentralized exchange and liquidity hub in the Ethereum ecosystem that grew out of Aerodrome, the popular DEX on Base. Users swap tokens, earn rewards for providing liquidity and launch new assets, while token holders vote on how emissions are distributed.
aevo: Aevo is a decentralized derivatives exchange for trading options and perpetual futures on its own Ethereum-based rollup. The project grew out of the Ribbon Finance options vault protocol; AEVO is used for governance.
afc: Arsenal Fan Token (AFC) is the official fan token of Arsenal, the football club from London, launched through Socios.com on the Chiliz Chain. Holders vote in club polls and can win rewards and fan experiences.
afl: Aflac is a US insurer based in Columbus, Georgia, founded in 1955. It sells supplemental health and life insurance in the US and Japan, where it earns most of its revenue, and is known for its duck mascot.
agg: iShares Core U.S. Aggregate Bond (AGG) is BlackRock's ETF on the broad US investment-grade bond market, from government to corporate debt.
agi: Delysium is a project building an AI-powered virtual society on blockchain, where people and AI virtual beings, including its AI agent Lucy, coexist and interact. AGI is the ecosystem's token, used for payments, rewards and governance.
agix: SingularityNET is a decentralized marketplace for AI services, founded in 2017 by Dr Ben Goertzel, known for his work on the robot Sophia. In 2024 the project merged with Fetch.ai and Ocean Protocol into the ASI Alliance.
agl: Apex Gold Ledger (AGL) is a real-world asset (RWA) token on Ethereum built around gold. The project links its token to gold-related assets, aiming to make them tradable on the blockchain.
agld: Adventure Gold (AGLD) is a token created in 2021 by the community around Loot, an NFT project by Vine co-founder Dom Hofmann. Holders of Loot bags could claim AGLD for free as the in-game currency of future Loot-world games.
agricultural-bank-of-china: Agricultural Bank of China is one of China's four big state-owned banks, headquartered in Beijing and founded in 1951. It has one of the widest branch networks in the country, including villages and small towns, and lends to farmers and the agricultural sector.
agrs: Agoras (AGRS) is the token of Tau Net, a long-running project led by Ohad Asor that is building software users can control with logical specifications in plain language. Agoras is planned as a knowledge and computing marketplace on top of Tau.
aht: AhaToken (AHT) is the token of Aha, a Korean knowledge Q&A platform where experts answer users' questions. People earn tokens for asking, answering and curating content, and the system is designed to filter out spam and promotional posts.
ai: Gensyn is a decentralized network for machine learning, founded in London in 2020, that connects spare computing hardware worldwide so anyone can train and run AI models. Its token AI pays for compute and rewards those who verify the work.
ai-fr: Air Liquide is a French world leader in industrial and medical gases, founded in Paris in 1902. It supplies oxygen, nitrogen, hydrogen and other gases to steelmakers, chemical plants, electronics makers and hospitals, and delivers oxygen to patients at home.
aia: DeAgentAI (AIA) is infrastructure for creating, running and coordinating autonomous AI agents in Web3, giving them identity, memory, lifecycle management and consensus tools. Its first live product, AlphaX, is an AI engine that gives short-term price-trend signals for Bitcoin and Ether.
aia-group: AIA Group is a Hong Kong insurer and the largest independent life insurer in the Asia-Pacific region. Its history began in Shanghai in 1919; it sells life, health and retirement products in China, Thailand, Singapore and other Asian markets.
aic: AI Companions (AIC) is a crypto project building customizable AI virtual companions: users create and chat with interactive digital characters whose looks and personality they can shape. The AIC token is used for payments and features inside the platform.
aig: American International Group (AIG) is a global insurance company based in New York, founded in 1919 in Shanghai. Today it focuses on commercial and personal property and casualty insurance for businesses and individuals in many countries; it is also remembered for its 2008 US government rescue.
ain: Infinity Ground is blockchain infrastructure for "vibe coders", where anyone can create and own decentralized apps using natural language and AI agents. AIN is the ecosystem token.
aio: OlaXBT (AIO) is an AI project for crypto traders that uses AI agents to analyse market data, sentiment and on-chain activity and to deliver trading insights and signals; AIO is the token used across its platform.
aiot: OKZOO (AIOT) is a crypto project focused on artificial intelligence, running on BNB Chain. Its AIOT token first went on sale through an IDO in Binance Wallet and is used across the project's apps.
aioz: AIOZ Network (AIOZ) is a DePIN network for data storage, video streaming and AI computing. Participants share their computers' resources as network nodes and earn AIOZ tokens, which are also used to pay for the network's services.
aipf: AI Powered Finance (AIPF) is a decentralized finance project that runs liquidity management, rewards and system stability through smart contracts combined with automated, AI-assisted rules, aiming to reduce manual intervention.
air: Airbus is a European aerospace group headquartered in Leiden with main plants in Toulouse and Hamburg, founded in 1970. It is one of the world's two biggest makers of passenger jets, such as the A320 and A350, and also builds helicopters, military aircraft and satellites.
aix: AI XOVIA is a project in which artificial intelligence analyzes crypto, forex and stock markets around the clock, along with on-chain data and social media sentiment, and builds trading strategies from it. The AIX token is part of the project's ecosystem.
aixbt: aixbt is an AI agent launched on the Virtuals Protocol platform on the Base network that tracks hundreds of crypto influencers on X and publishes analysis of market narratives. The AIXBT token unlocks access to the agent's advanced terminal.
aiz: Assurant is a US insurance and protection company. It provides device protection and trade-in programs for mobile phones, extended warranties for cars and electronics, and renters and lender-placed home insurance, mostly sold through partners such as phone carriers, retailers and banks.
ajg: Arthur J. Gallagher is a US insurance broker based in Rolling Meadows, Illinois, founded in 1927. It helps businesses buy insurance and reinsurance, advises on employee benefits and handles insurance claims.
ake: AKEDO is a multi-agent AI platform for automatic content creation: users can build simple games in minutes just by describing them in plain language. The platform runs on large language models; AKE is the ecosystem token.
akt: Akash Network is a decentralized cloud computing marketplace built with the Cosmos SDK, where server owners rent out CPU and GPU capacity. It is a cheaper alternative to AWS or Google Cloud that is popular for AI workloads; AKT is used for payments and staking.
al-rajhi-bank: Al Rajhi Bank is one of the world's largest Islamic banks, based in Riyadh and founded by the Al Rajhi family. It operates under Sharia rules without interest and leads Saudi Arabia in retail lending, money transfers and mobile banking.
alc: Alcon is a Swiss eye-care company based in Geneva and a global leader in the field. It makes Dailies contact lenses, eye drops and equipment for cataract and other eye surgery; it was spun off from Novartis in 2019.
alch: Alchemist AI (ALCH) is a no-code platform that builds software from a plain-text description, so users don't need to program. People generate games, websites and tools with AI, and the ALCH token gives access to platform features.
alcx: Alchemix (ALCX) is the governance token of Alchemix, an Ethereum DeFi protocol known for "self-repaying loans": users deposit assets, borrow synthetic alUSD or alETH, and the yield earned on the deposit gradually pays the loan off.
ald: ALD (Aladdin) is a BNB Chain token of a project that presents itself as a gateway for real businesses and real-world assets (RWA) entering Web3, connecting projects with real users and industry resources to on-chain tools.
ale: Allegro is Poland's largest online marketplace, founded in 1999 and run from Poznań, with the holding company registered in Luxembourg. Millions of shoppers buy from merchants on the platform, which also operates in Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary and Slovenia.
aleo: Aleo (ALEO) is a layer-1 blockchain for private applications, where smart contracts run with zero-knowledge proofs. User data stays hidden while the network only verifies that computations are correct; ALEO is used for fees and rewards.
aleph: Aleph Cloud, formerly aleph.im, is a decentralized cloud network started in 2018 in France. It offers storage, computing and data indexing for Web3 apps and AI workloads without relying on a single provider; ALEPH pays for resources and rewards node operators.
alex: ALEX Lab (ALEX) is a DeFi platform for Bitcoin built on Stacks, a Bitcoin layer. It offers a decentralized exchange, a token launchpad and a bridge, and ALEX is used for governance and rewards.
algo: Algorand is a blockchain for smart contracts and payments founded by MIT professor and Turing Award winner Silvio Micali. Its Pure Proof of Stake consensus gives fast transaction finality; ALGO pays fees and is used to take part in consensus.
ali: Artificial Liquid Intelligence (ALI) is the token of Alethea AI, the project that created the iNFT standard: NFTs with built-in AI personalities that can talk and interact. ALI is used to create and power these intelligent NFTs and to govern the protocol.
alibaba: Alibaba Group is a Chinese technology company based in Hangzhou, founded by Jack Ma in 1999. It runs China's largest online marketplaces Taobao and Tmall, the international store AliExpress, the cloud business Alibaba Cloud and the logistics network Cainiao.
alice: My Neighbor Alice is a multiplayer online game on the Chromia blockchain in the spirit of Animal Crossing: players own virtual islands as NFTs, build, farm and socialize. ALICE is the game token used for purchases and governance.
align: Aligned (ALIGN) is the token of Aligned, a platform that helps fintechs and enterprises build on Ethereum through one integration covering wallets, rollups, interoperability and zero-knowledge services. Its proof aggregation service batches many ZK proofs into one to cut verification costs.
alinma-bank: Alinma Bank is a Saudi Islamic bank headquartered in Riyadh, founded in 2006. It offers Sharia-compliant retail and corporate banking, financing and investment services across the Kingdom.
all: Allstate is one of the largest US insurers, based in Northbrook, Illinois, and founded in 1931 as part of Sears. It insures cars, homes and property under the Allstate and National General brands and is known for the slogan "You're in good hands".
all-au: Aristocrat Leisure is an Australian maker of gaming machines from Sydney, founded in 1953. It builds slot machines for casinos around the world and also makes mobile games through its Product Madness studio.
alle: Allegion is a security products company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, spun off from Ingersoll Rand in 2013. It makes locks, door hardware, electronic access control and workforce productivity systems under brands such as Schlage, Von Duprin, LCN and CISA.
allo: Allora (ALLO) is a decentralized AI network that brings together many specialized models and combines their forecasts into one more accurate result. Anyone can contribute a model, data or verification; AI agents and DeFi apps use the outputs in real time.
alny: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is an American biotech company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 2002. It was the first to bring RNA interference (RNAi) medicines to market, which silence disease-causing genes; its drugs include Onpattro and Amvuttra for transthyretin amyloidosis.
alph: Alephium is a layer-1 blockchain that combines sharded proof-of-work with smart contracts. It uses a UTXO model like Bitcoin, aims for energy-efficient mining and high throughput, and its mainnet launched in 2021; ALPH is the native coin for fees and mining rewards.
alpha: Alpha Arcade (ALPHA) is a decentralized prediction market on Algorand where users trade yes/no contracts on sports, crypto, culture, economics and news events. Trading fees are shared with ALPHA stakers in USDC.
alpine: Alpine F1 Team Fan Token (ALPINE) is the fan token of the BWT Alpine Formula 1 team, the first F1 team on Binance's Fan Token platform. Holders vote in team polls and get bonuses and access to events.
alt: AltLayer (ALT) is a protocol for quickly launching custom rollup blockchains (optimistic and zk) on a «rollup-as-a-service» basis. It uses restaking through EigenLayer for extra network security; ALT is used for staking and governance.
alu: Altura (ALU) is the token of a platform that helps developers build, scale and monetize Web3 and AI-powered games. Its APIs and SDKs simplify adding blockchain in-game items and intelligent AI characters to games.
aluminum: Aluminium is a light metal used in aircraft, cars, packaging and construction. Producing it takes huge amounts of electricity, so its price also depends on energy costs.
alv: Allianz is Europe's largest insurance company, based in Munich and founded in 1890. It sells property, car and life insurance in more than 70 countries and manages huge investment funds through PIMCO and Allianz Global Investors.
am: Dassault Aviation is a French aircraft maker founded by Marcel Dassault. It builds the Rafale multirole fighter for France and export customers as well as Falcon business jets; its main shareholder is the Dassault group.
amat: Applied Materials is the world's largest supplier of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, founded in 1967 and based in Santa Clara, California. Its machines deposit and process layers of material on silicon wafers for TSMC, Samsung, Intel and other chipmakers.
amcr: Amcor is one of the world's largest packaging companies, with Australian roots, legal registration in Jersey and headquarters in Zurich. It makes flexible packaging, bottles and containers for food, drinks, medicines and cosmetics, and combined with Berry Global in 2025.
amd: AMD (Advanced Micro Devices) is a US chip designer from Santa Clara, California, founded in 1969. It makes Ryzen and EPYC processors, Radeon graphics cards and Instinct AI accelerators, plus chips for PlayStation and Xbox consoles; it is led by Lisa Su.
amd-token: AMD • Robinhood Token is a tokenized version of AMD shares issued by Robinhood for its customers in the European Union. It follows the price of the US-listed stock and can be traded around the clock on a blockchain.
ame: AMETEK is a US maker of electronic instruments and electromechanical devices from Berwyn, Pennsylvania, founded in 1930. It makes measuring and analytical instruments, sensors, motors and components for aerospace, medical, energy and industrial customers.
amgn: Amgen is one of the world's largest biotech companies, based in Thousand Oaks, California, and founded in 1980. It develops medicines for osteoporosis, cancer, inflammatory and cardiovascular diseases, including Enbrel, Prolia and Repatha.
amo: AMO Coin (AMO) is the token of AMO, a blockchain project from South Korea that builds a marketplace for data from connected cars, letting drivers share vehicle data with companies that use it. AMO is used for payments in that marketplace.
amp: Ameriprise Financial is a US financial company from Minneapolis that was spun off from American Express in 2005. It offers financial adviser services, manages investments through Columbia Threadneedle and sells life insurance and annuities.
amp-token: Amp (AMP) is an Ethereum token that serves as digital collateral for instant, guaranteed payments. It is used by the Flexa payment network: while a blockchain transaction confirms, AMP collateral guarantees that the merchant gets paid.
ams: Amadeus is a Spanish IT company from Madrid and the world's largest travel booking system, founded in 1987 by Air France, Iberia, Lufthansa and SAS. Airlines, travel agencies, hotels and airports use its software to sell tickets and serve travellers.
amt: American Tower is a Boston-based real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns and leases out cell towers and other communications sites. Mobile operators rent space on its towers in the US, Latin America, Europe, Africa and India; it also owns CoreSite data centers.
amxb: América Móvil is a Mexican telecommunications company based in Mexico City and controlled by the family of billionaire Carlos Slim. Under the Telcel and Claro brands it provides mobile, internet and TV services in Mexico and more than a dozen countries across Latin America.
amzn: Amazon is a US company based in Seattle, founded by Jeff Bezos in 1994 as an online bookstore. Today it runs a huge online store, the AWS cloud, Prime subscriptions, Prime Video streaming and the Alexa voice assistant.
amzn-token: This is a Robinhood stock token that tracks Amazon shares, offered by Robinhood to eligible customers in Europe as a blockchain-based token. Amazon, founded by Jeff Bezos in 1994 and based in Seattle, runs the world's biggest online store, the Prime subscription and the cloud leader Amazon Web Services (AWS).
andy: ANDY ETH (ANDY) is a memecoin on Ethereum based on Andy, Pepe the Frog's best friend from Matt Furie's comic "Boy's Club". It is a community token with no stated utility beyond the meme.
anet: Arista Networks is a US networking-equipment maker based in Santa Clara, California, founded in 2004 with Andy Bechtolsheim among its founders. It supplies high-speed switches and its EOS software for data centers and AI cloud clusters at major tech companies.
anime: Animecoin (ANIME) is a community token for anime culture backed by Azuki, a well-known Web3 anime brand. It aims to turn fans from passive viewers into participants who help shape and co-own anime projects.
ankr: Ankr (ANKR) is a provider of decentralized Web3 infrastructure: it gives developers access to nodes of dozens of blockchains via RPC and offers liquid staking services. The ANKR token is used to pay for services and for staking.
anon: Hey Anon is an AI agent platform for DeFi, created by Daniele Sesta, that lets users research markets and carry out on-chain actions such as swaps or bridging by giving simple chat commands. ANON is its token.
ansem: The Black Bull (ANSEM) is a community memecoin on Solana launched through Pump.fun, built around the image of a black bull that always charges forward. The project website shows the token's on-chain data in real time and offers a meme terminal and community liquidity pools.
ant: Autonomi (formerly SAFE Network by MaidSafe, a Scottish project started in 2006) is a decentralized network that stores data securely across everyday devices, with privacy by default. ANT is the token used to pay for storage and reward node operators.
anta-sports: Anta Sports is a Chinese sportswear and footwear maker from Jinjiang in Fujian province, founded in 1991. Besides its Anta brand, it runs FILA in China and Descente and holds a stake in Amer Sports (Salomon, Arc'teryx, Wilson).
antfun: ANT.FUN is a Web3 social trading wallet that works with several major blockchains. It combines a wallet, on-chain analytics, tracking of other wallets, trading signals and trader chats, so users can find and execute trades in one app.
anthropic: Anthropic PreStocks is a token on Solana from the PreStocks platform that tracks the value of pre-IPO shares of Anthropic, the US AI company behind Claude. It is not issued by Anthropic and gives no shareholder rights.
anvl: Anvil (ANVL) is a set of Ethereum smart contracts that manage collateral and issue fully secured credit, such as letters of credit — a digital version of a bank cheque backed by verified funds. This reduces counterparty risk; ANVL is the protocol's token.
anyone: ANyONe Protocol (formerly ator) is a decentralized privacy network based on onion routing, similar to Tor, run by community relays and hardware. Any app can route its traffic through it for anonymity; the ANYONE token rewards relay operators.
anz: ANZ (Australia and New Zealand Banking Group) is one of Australia's four biggest banks, headquartered in Melbourne. It is also the largest bank in New Zealand and serves retail, business and institutional clients across Asia-Pacific.
ao: AO (ao Computer) is a decentralized "hyper-parallel computer" built on Arweave storage. It can run huge numbers of processes and AI agents in parallel while keeping all data permanently stored; AO is the network's native token.
aon: Aon is a global professional services firm headquartered in Dublin with roots in Chicago. It is one of the world's largest insurance and reinsurance brokers and also advises companies on risk, pensions and employee health benefits.
aot: Airports of Thailand (AOT) is a state-controlled Thai company that runs six of the country's international airports: Suvarnabhumi and Don Mueang in Bangkok, plus Phuket, Chiang Mai, Hat Yai and Chiang Rai. It earns from airport fees, shop rents and duty-free concessions.
apa: APA Corporation is a US oil and gas producer from Houston and the parent of Apache, founded in 1954. It explores for and produces oil and natural gas in the Permian Basin, Egypt and the UK North Sea, and has a major discovery offshore Suriname.
apd: Air Products is a US industrial gases company based in Allentown, Pennsylvania, founded in 1940. It produces oxygen, nitrogen, hydrogen and helium for factories, hospitals and electronics makers, and builds equipment for liquefying natural gas.
ape: ApeCoin (APE) is a token linked to the Bored Ape Yacht Club NFT collection by Yuga Labs, launched in 2022. It is used in games and projects across the ecosystem, holders vote in ApeCoin DAO, and it powers its own network, ApeChain.
apepe: Ape and Pepe (APEPE) is a meme coin that combines two popular meme figures, an ape and Pepe the frog, as a symbol of small retail investors. It has no technological function and relies solely on community activity.
apex: ApeX Protocol is a decentralized exchange for trading perpetual futures, spot, tokenized stocks and prediction markets while keeping control of your own assets. The project is backed by the Bybit exchange; APEX is the governance and rewards token.
apg: APi Group is a US building-safety services company based in New Brighton, Minnesota, founded in 1926. It installs, inspects and maintains fire-protection and sprinkler systems, fire alarms, security systems, elevators and escalators for offices, factories, hospitals and warehouses.
aph: Amphenol is an American maker of electronic and fiber-optic connectors, cables and sensors based in Connecticut, founded in 1932. Its components are used in data centers, cars, aircraft, military equipment and mobile devices.
api3: Api3 (API3) is an oracle project in which price data for DeFi is signed by the API providers themselves rather than by middlemen. Its OEV mechanism returns part of the profit from liquidations to apps, and the API3 token is used for staking and DAO governance.
apm: apM Coin (APM) is a South Korean blockchain token linked to apM, a group of fashion wholesale malls in Seoul's Dongdaemun market. It is used for customer rewards and payments between buyers and clothing sellers in the apM ecosystem.
apo: Apollo Global Management is a US investment firm based in New York, founded in 1990 by Leon Black, Josh Harris and Marc Rowan. It specialises in private credit and private equity and owns the retirement and insurance company Athene.
app: AppLovin is a US company based in Palo Alto that sells AI-driven advertising technology. Its Axon engine helps mobile game and app developers, as well as online stores, win new users and earn money from ads.
apr-token: Capricorn is an order-flow coordination layer for high-performance blockchains: its engine classifies trades in real time and routes them so traders and market makers lose less to inefficient execution. APR is the ecosystem token.
apt: Aptos is a proof-of-stake layer-1 blockchain created by former developers of Meta's Diem project. It uses the Move programming language and executes transactions in parallel; APT pays network fees and secures the chain through staking.
aptm: Apertum is a Layer-1 blockchain built as a subnet (L1) on Avalanche, designed to run decentralized apps with fast, low-cost transactions. APTM is its native coin, used to pay network fees and to support the ecosystem.
apu: Apu Apustaja (APU) is an Ethereum memecoin based on Apu, the small green frog character popular in internet meme culture. It is a community token with no utility beyond trading.
aqua: Aquarius is a protocol on the Stellar network that rewards people who provide liquidity to Stellar's decentralized exchange and AMM pools. AQUA holders vote on which trading pairs receive rewards, and the project runs its own AMM.
ar: Arweave is a decentralized network for permanent data storage: you pay once and the file is meant to be stored "forever" on what it calls the permaweb. The project was founded by Sam Williams; the AO computing platform also runs on Arweave, and AR pays for storage.
arara: Araracoin (ARARA) is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain that uses a macaw mascot and funds wildlife conservation: part of the supply and a transaction fee go to environmental projects, and holders vote on how the conservation fund is spent.
arb: Arbitrum is the largest layer-2 network for Ethereum, developed by Offchain Labs. Its optimistic rollup technology makes transactions much cheaper and faster while keeping Ethereum's security; ARB is the ecosystem's governance token.
arc: AI Rig Complex (ARC) is a Solana project that develops Rig, a Rust framework for building AI agents and apps powered by large language models. The ARC token is used by the project's community.
ardr: Ardor is a blockchain platform with a parent-chain and child-chain design, built by the company Jelurida and launched in 2018 as the successor to Nxt. Businesses can create their own child chains, while ARDR secures the whole network.
ares: Ares Management is a US alternative investment manager from Los Angeles, founded in 1997. It specializes in private lending to businesses and also invests in real estate, infrastructure and private equity on behalf of pension funds and other investors.
arg: The Argentine Football Association Fan Token (ARG) is the fan token of Argentina's national football team on the Chiliz blockchain, used through the Socios.com app. Fans who hold it can vote in polls, enter quizzes and win rewards such as merchandise and experiences.
aria: Aria.AI (ARIA) is an experimental game development and publishing project that combines AI technology and the idea of Disney-style immersive worlds with its own intellectual property. The ARIA token is used within the project's ecosystem.
ariax: ARIA Network (ARIAX) is a proof-of-stake blockchain built on Substrate that powers ARIA Pay, a checkout option letting merchants accept crypto through one integration while customers pay from the exchange or wallet they already use.
ark: ARK is a blockchain project launched in 2017 that provides tools for building your own blockchains and linking them together. Its aim is a web of connected networks, and the ARK token is used for fees and for voting for delegates who secure the network.
arkk: ARK Innovation (ARKK) is an actively managed fund run by Cathie Wood's ARK Invest that bets on 'disruptive' technologies such as AI, genomics and fintech. It is very volatile.
arkm: Arkham (ARKM) is a blockchain analytics platform that uses AI to link anonymous addresses to real companies and people, and it also runs its own crypto exchange. Users track the flows of big players; ARKM is used for rewards and fee discounts.
arm: Arm Holdings is a British company based in Cambridge, founded in 1990. It designs processor architectures and licenses them to chipmakers; almost every smartphone in the world runs on Arm designs. SoftBank owns a controlling stake.
arpa: ARPA is a decentralized network of threshold BLS signatures for secure computation on blockchains. Its best-known product is Randcast, a verifiable randomness service for games and NFTs; ARPA is used for payments and node staking.
arrr: Pirate Chain (ARRR) is a cryptocurrency with full, mandatory privacy: every transaction on the network is shielded with zk-SNARKs. Unlike coins with optional anonymity, it is impossible to send a transparent transaction, which makes network analysis harder.
arw-token: Arowana (ARW) is a real-world asset (RWA) platform on Arbitrum that issues tokens backed by physical assets, so they can be held and traded on-chain. ARW is used for governance of the platform.
arx: Arcium (ARX) is an encrypted computing network closely tied to Solana. It lets applications process private data without revealing it, for hidden order books, AI and DeFi; the ARX token pays for computation and is staked by node operators.
ascend: Ascend is a multi-chain prediction perpetuals platform: instead of simply betting on an outcome, users trade the probability of events with leverage and can enter or exit at any time. Trades run off-chain and are settled in batches with zero-knowledge proofs on Midnight, a Cardano partner chain.
ase-technology: ASE Technology Holding is a Taiwanese company based in Kaohsiung and the world's largest contractor for chip packaging and testing. It takes finished silicon wafers from chipmakers and turns them into ready-to-mount components; it was formed in 2018 by merging ASE and SPIL.
asels: Aselsan is Turkey's largest defense electronics maker, headquartered in Ankara and founded in 1975. It builds radars, communication systems, electronic warfare equipment, optics and fire-control systems for the Turkish military and export; its controlling shareholder is the armed forces' foundation.
asianpaint: Asian Paints is India's largest paint maker, based in Mumbai and founded in 1942. It produces decorative paints for homes and industrial coatings, and also sells kitchen and bathroom products in India and other countries in Asia and Africa.
asm: ASM International is a Dutch maker of chipmaking equipment from Almere, founded in 1968. It is the world leader in atomic layer deposition (ALD), a technology essential for building the most advanced transistors; its customers are the largest chipmakers.
asm-token: Assemble AI (ASM) is the token of a project behind News3 (NS3), an AI news agent for crypto. NS3 uses an OpenAI reasoning model to summarize crypto and economic trends, explain past cases and possible ripple effects, in 12 languages.
asml: ASML is a Dutch company from Veldhoven and the world's only maker of EUV lithography machines, which are needed to produce the most advanced microchips. TSMC, Samsung and Intel buy its equipment; it was founded in 1984 as a joint venture of Philips and ASM International.
asml-etf: ASML is a Dutch company based in Veldhoven, founded in 1984, and the only maker of EUV lithography machines in the world. The most advanced microchips cannot be made without its equipment, so its customers include TSMC, Samsung and Intel.
asp: Aspecta (ASP) is blockchain infrastructure for valuing and trading illiquid assets such as pre-launch tokens, locked tokens, private company shares and real-world assets, using attestations and on-chain price discovery to give them liquidity earlier.
asr: AS Roma Fan Token (ASR) is the fan token of Italian football club AS Roma on the Socios.com platform (Chiliz blockchain). It lets supporters vote in club polls and earn rewards and exclusive perks.
asset: REAL (ASSET) is an EVM-compatible layer-1 blockchain built specifically for tokenizing, insuring and trading real-world financial assets. The token powers the network, whose goal is to bring traditional finance on-chain.
ast-token: AirSwap (AST) is the token of AirSwap, a decentralized peer-to-peer trading network on Ethereum launched in 2017. Traders swap tokens directly with market makers at quoted prices, and AST is staked for governance and a share of protocol fees.
aster: Aster is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange (perp DEX) running mainly on BNB Chain and other networks. It combines trading without handing funds to an exchange with features of professional platforms; ASTER is the governance and rewards token.
asteroid: Asteroid Shiba (ASTEROID) is a Shiba Inu dog-themed memecoin with a space theme. Like most memecoins, it has no business or assets behind it, and its price depends mainly on community attention and trading.
astr: Astar (ASTR) is a blockchain ecosystem founded by Japanese entrepreneur Sota Watanabe. It started as a Polkadot parachain and later expanded to Soneium, an Ethereum network; the project is popular in Japan and works with large corporations, and ASTR is its main token.
at: APRO is a decentralized oracle that combines off-chain data processing with on-chain verification. It feeds smart contracts with prices, real-world asset data and event outcomes for DeFi, AI agents and prediction markets; AT is the network's token.
atd: Alimentation Couche-Tard is a Canadian company from Laval, Quebec, founded in 1980. It runs thousands of convenience stores and gas stations across North America, Europe and Asia under the Circle K and Couche-Tard brands.
ath: Aethir (ATH) is a decentralized GPU cloud for companies that need powerful graphics processors for artificial intelligence and cloud gaming. Hardware owners rent out their GPUs to the network and clients lease them; ATH is used for payments and staking.
ati: ATI is a US maker of specialty materials headquartered in Dallas. It produces titanium, nickel superalloys and stainless steel, plus complex parts for jet engines, defence, energy and medicine; aerospace is its main market.
atlas: Star Atlas is a space-exploration strategy game built on the Solana blockchain with Unreal Engine graphics, where players own ships and land as NFTs, mine resources and fight for territory. ATLAS is the in-game currency, while the separate POLIS token is used for governance.
atm: Atletico Madrid Fan Token (ATM) is the fan token of Spanish football club Atlético de Madrid on the Socios.com platform, running on the Chiliz chain. Holders vote in club polls and get access to VIP rewards and exclusive promotions.
ato: Atmos Energy is the largest natural-gas-only distributor in the United States, headquartered in Dallas. It supplies gas to millions of homes and businesses in eight states, mostly in Texas, and owns gas pipelines and storage.
atom: Cosmos is an ecosystem of independent blockchains linked by the IBC protocol, which lets them exchange data and tokens. Dozens of networks are built with its tools (Cosmos SDK, CometBFT); ATOM is used for staking and governance of the Cosmos Hub.
atone: AtomOne (ATONE) is the staking and governance token of AtomOne, a community-driven fork of the Cosmos Hub focused on decentralization and a formal on-chain constitution. Transaction and IBC fees are paid in a separate token, PHOTON.
atos: Atoshi (ATOS) is the coin of the Atoshi project, which is building its own public blockchain with smart contracts and NFTs, inspired by Bitcoin and Ethereum. Its mobile app has a large user base that started in mainland China and spread across Asia.
ats: Alltoscan (ATS) is a project building an open-source block explorer that works with all rollups, the layer-2 networks built on top of blockchains such as Ethereum. It lets users look up transactions, addresses and tokens across these networks in one place.
auction: Bounce (AUCTION) is a decentralized platform for auctions and new token launches, founded in 2020. It helps projects run token and NFT sales, and AUCTION is used for staking and access to launches.
audd: Australian Digital Dollar (AUDD) is a stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the Australian dollar and backed by reserves held in Australia. Issued by a company of the Novatti group, it lets users hold and send Australian dollars on several blockchains.
audf: Forte AUD (AUDF) is a stablecoin designed to equal one Australian dollar, issued by the Australian company Forte. It lets businesses and people hold and move Australian dollars on blockchains for payments and settlement.
audio: Audius is a decentralized music streaming platform founded in 2018 in San Francisco. Artists upload tracks directly and keep control of their work, while AUDIO is used for staking, governance and rewards.
audx: Aussie Dollar Token (AUDX) is a stablecoin designed to keep a 1:1 value with the Australian dollar. It brings the Australian currency onto the blockchain, so it can be sent, traded or used in crypto apps the way dollar stablecoins are.
auki: Auki is a project that makes the physical world accessible to AI, robots and smart glasses. Its posemesh protocol gives devices a shared spatial understanding so they can navigate and find information inside real buildings; AUKI is the network's token.
aurora: Aurora is an Ethereum-compatible virtual machine (EVM) built on the NEAR Protocol blockchain. It lets developers run Ethereum apps with high throughput and low fees; the AURORA token is used for governance.
auto: Hastra AUTO is a token that gives exposure to the yield of a pool of US consumer auto loans on Figure's Democratized Prime platform. Holders earn the interest paid by real car-loan borrowers, minus the Hastra platform fee.
ava: AVA is the token of Travala.com, a travel platform for booking hotels, flights and tours with cryptocurrency. AVA holders get discounts and cashback, and Travala was one of the first major travel services to accept crypto.
avail: Avail (AVAIL) is a modular blockchain focused on data availability: it stores and verifies transaction data for rollups and other chains so they can scale cheaply. It was spun out of Polygon in 2023; AVAIL pays fees and secures the network through staking.
avax: Avalanche is a smart-contract platform developed by Ava Labs, led by Emin Gün Sirer. It lets teams launch their own blockchains (L1s) for games, finance and business; AVAX pays fees and is used for staking.
avgo: Broadcom is a US company from Palo Alto, California, that designs semiconductors for networking, data centers, smartphones and custom AI accelerators for big tech companies. Since buying VMware, it is also a major supplier of enterprise software.
avici: Avici (AVICI) is a self-custodial crypto neobank on Solana that offers a Visa debit card for spending crypto and aims to add on-chain credit. Its token was launched through the MetaDAO launchpad.
avl: Avalon Labs (AVL) builds an on-chain financial center for Bitcoin holders: loans backed by BTC, a Bitcoin-backed stablecoin, yield-earning accounts and a crypto credit card. It started as a large issuer of Bitcoin-backed loans; AVL is the ecosystem's governance token.
avnt: Veranta (AVNT) is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange on the Base network where people can trade not only crypto but also real-world assets such as currencies, commodities and stocks. The AVNT token is used for governance and incentives.
avt-token: Aventus is a London-based blockchain project that started in 2017 with a ticketing protocol meant to stop ticket touting and fraud, and later became a layer-2 network that gives businesses faster, cheaper transactions secured by Ethereum. AVT is used for fees and staking.
awe: AWE Network is a project building identity and payment infrastructure for the AI agent economy. It began as the Autonomous World Engine, an engine for multi-agent worlds where many agents act at once; AWE is the ecosystem's governance token.
awin: AlphaWin (AWIN) is the token of a platform that runs open tournaments for financial prediction models: data scientists and quants submit forecasts and are rewarded based on how accurate they turn out to be going forward.
awk: American Water Works is the largest private water and wastewater utility in the United States, founded in 1886. From its headquarters in Camden, New Jersey, it supplies drinking water and treats wastewater for millions of people in more than ten states.
axis: Axis Robotics (Axis AI) is a data infrastructure project for robotics and physical AI. Users control robots in simulations through tasks such as grasping objects and pose control, creating training data for models in exchange for crypto rewards.
axisbank: Axis Bank is one of India's largest private banks, based in Mumbai and founded in 1993 as UTI Bank. It offers retail and corporate banking, credit cards and loans, and in 2023 acquired Citibank's Indian consumer business.
axl: Axelar (AXL) is a cross-chain network that passes messages and assets between dozens of blockchains, including Ethereum, Cosmos and Solana. Developers use a simple API to build apps that work on several networks at once; AXL is used for validator staking and fees.
axon: Axon Enterprise is a US company from Arizona known for TASER stun guns, which gave the company its name until 2017. It also makes police body cameras and sells cloud software for storing evidence and running law-enforcement work.
axp: American Express is a US payments company based in New York, founded in 1850. It issues Amex credit and charge cards, processes the transactions itself and lends to cardholders, and is known for its rewards programs and travel services for affluent customers.
axs: Axie Infinity (AXS) is the governance token of Axie Infinity, a game by Vietnamese studio Sky Mavis in which players collect and battle fantasy NFT creatures. The game became a symbol of the 2021 play-to-earn boom and runs on the Ronin network.
azero: Aleph Zero is a layer-1 blockchain launched in 2021, developed largely by a team from Poland, that uses its own AlephBFT consensus for fast, low-cost transactions with quick finality. It focuses on privacy features based on zero-knowledge proofs and also has an Ethereum-compatible EVM layer; AZERO pays fees and is staked.
azn-etf: AstraZeneca is a British-Swedish pharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, formed in 1999 by the merger of Astra and Zeneca. It develops medicines for cancer, cardiovascular and respiratory diseases and is known for the COVID-19 vaccine developed with Oxford.
azo: AutoZone is the largest auto parts retailer in the US, headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, and founded in 1979. It sells parts, oils and accessories for cars and pickups to do-it-yourself owners and repair shops in the US, Mexico and Brazil.
aztec: Aztec is a privacy-focused layer-2 network on Ethereum: developers build apps in which users' transactions and data can be hidden using zero-knowledge proofs. The London-based team created its own programming language, Noir.
b: BUILDon (B) is a meme token on BNB Chain that emerged around the USD1 stablecoin and the community of "builders" in its ecosystem. Its value rests on community interest and trading rather than on a specific product.
b2: B² Network (BSquared) is a Bitcoin layer-2 that uses zero-knowledge proofs to extend what bitcoin can do. It adds smart contracts and DeFi while anchoring settlement to the Bitcoin network; B2 is the network token.
b2m: B2M is the token of Bit2Me, a Spanish cryptocurrency exchange based in Madrid and founded in 2014. Holding B2M gives users lower trading fees, rewards and other benefits on the Bit2Me platform.
b3: B3 is a project created by former members of the Base team that builds infrastructure for games, AI agents and automated workflows that execute on-chain transactions. Its main product, B3OS, is a workflow automation platform for agents.
b3tr: VeBetterDAO is a platform on the VeChain blockchain that rewards people for sustainable everyday actions, such as recycling, cycling or buying second-hand, through apps connected to it. Users earn B3TR tokens, which can be converted into VOT3 to vote on how rewards are shared between apps.
ba: Boeing is an American aerospace giant founded in Seattle in 1916 by William Boeing. It builds the 737, 777 and 787 passenger jets, military aircraft, satellites and space systems, and services airline fleets worldwide.
baby: Babylon (BABY) is a protocol that lets bitcoin holders stake BTC to secure other proof-of-stake blockchains without bridges or custodians, while the coins stay on the Bitcoin network. It was founded by Stanford researchers including David Tse; BABY is the token of Babylon's own chain.
babydoge: Baby Doge Coin (BABYDOGE) is a memecoin on BNB Chain launched in 2021 as the «child» of Dogecoin. Part of every transaction is burned and part is distributed to holders; the community is also known for charity work supporting animal shelters.
bac: Bank of America is one of the largest banks in the United States, headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It serves millions of individual and business customers and runs an investment bank and the Merrill brokerage; Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway is one of its biggest shareholders.
badger: Badger (BADGER) is the governance token of Badger DAO, a project launched in 2020 to bring bitcoin into decentralized finance on Ethereum. It offers vaults that earn yield on tokenized bitcoin and eBTC, a bitcoin-backed stablecoin-style asset.
baidu: Baidu is a Chinese internet company from Beijing, founded in 2000 by Robin Li. It runs China's largest search engine, develops the Ernie AI language model and cloud services, and operates the Apollo Go robotaxi service.
bajajfinsv: Bajaj Finserv is an Indian financial holding company from Pune and part of the Bajaj group. It holds controlling stakes in the lender Bajaj Finance and in the Bajaj Allianz general and life insurance companies.
bajfinance: Bajaj Finance is India's largest non-bank lender, based in Pune and part of the Bajaj Group. It offers consumer loans for electronics and appliances, personal and business loans, home loans and deposits to tens of millions of customers.
bal: Balancer is a DeFi protocol launched on Ethereum in 2020 that runs decentralised exchange pools with many tokens and custom weights, which also work like self-rebalancing index portfolios. BAL is its governance token.
ball: Ball Corporation is a US maker of aluminum cans and bottles based in Westminster, Colorado, founded in 1880 by the Ball brothers, famous for Ball glass jars. Today it supplies beverage cans to drinks brands worldwide.
bami: Banco BPM is Italy's third-largest bank, formed in 2017 by merging Banco Popolare with Banca Popolare di Milano. It serves individuals and small and medium-sized businesses, mainly in northern Italy.
ban: Comedian (BAN) is a meme token on Solana inspired by Maurizio Cattelan's controversial artwork «Comedian» — a banana duct-taped to a wall that sold at auction for millions of dollars in 2024.
banana: Banana Gun is a crypto trading ecosystem best known for its Telegram trading bot, which lets users buy and sell tokens quickly across several blockchains, plus the Banana Pro web terminal. BANANA holders receive a share of the bot's fees.
bananas31: Banana For Scale (BANANAS31) is a memecoin on BNB Chain inspired by a 2012 Reddit meme in which a banana is placed next to an object «for scale». It is a community token with no practical function whose price depends on interest in the meme.
band: Band Protocol (BAND) is a decentralized oracle founded in Thailand in 2017 that delivers outside data such as prices to blockchains and AI apps. It runs on its own BandChain blockchain in the Cosmos ecosystem.
bank: Lorenzo Protocol is an asset management platform for bitcoin and on-chain funds, running mainly on BNB Chain. It issues liquid bitcoin staking tokens such as stBTC and enzoBTC and yield products; BANK is the governance token.
bank-of-china: Bank of China is one of China's four big state-owned banks, headquartered in Beijing and founded in 1912. The most international of Chinese banks, it specializes in foreign-exchange and trade finance and has branches in dozens of countries.
bankroll: Bankroll (BANKROLL) is a Solana token paired with USDC: every transfer carries a 3% fee that is paid out to holders in USDC, and its trading pool is permanently locked, so liquidity cannot be withdrawn.
bar: FC Barcelona Fan Token (BAR) is the fan token of Spanish football club FC Barcelona on the Socios.com platform and the Chiliz blockchain. Holders vote in club polls and get bonuses, prizes and access to VIP events.
bara: Capybara Nation (BARA) is a capybara-themed Web3 game that runs inside Telegram. Players earn in-game coins, upgrade and level up quest cards and get extra tasks and rewards for inviting friends, a simple way to bring Telegram users into crypto.
bard: Lombard (BARD) is a protocol founded in 2024 that turns bitcoin into a yield-earning asset in DeFi. Users stake BTC through Babylon and receive LBTC, a liquid token that works across many blockchains; BARD is the governance token.
bas: BASF is the world's largest chemical company, based in Ludwigshafen, Germany, and founded in 1865. It makes basic chemicals, plastics, catalysts, coatings, crop protection products and battery materials; its main site is one of the biggest chemical complexes in the world.
bas-token: BNB Attestation Service (BAS) is a protocol for creating on-chain attestations on BNB Chain: verified records about identity, reputation or events that other apps can rely on. The BAS token is used within the service's ecosystem.
basecat: Basecat (BASECAT) is a cat-themed meme coin on Base, the Ethereum layer-2 network built by Coinbase. It is a community token driven by memes and has no built-in utility.
based: Based is a financial super-app built on Hyperliquid that lets users trade crypto, stocks and commodities from one interface. Accounts can be funded from a bank account or card, and BASED is the ecosystem's token.
bat: Basic Attention Token (BAT) is the token of the ad ecosystem of the Brave browser, created by Brendan Eich, the inventor of JavaScript and co-founder of Mozilla. Advertisers pay in BAT, and users who opt in to private ads get a share they can use to support websites and creators.
baton: baton (BATON) is a memecoin on the Solana blockchain created through a quick-launch platform and traded in the Pump.fun ecosystem. It has no business behind it; its price follows community hype.
bay: Marina Protocol (BAY) is a marketing-technology platform that turns ordinary quizzes, missions and events into Web3 campaigns with instant on-chain rewards. Social-login wallets and gasless onboarding let participants join without crypto experience, and brands run campaigns through SDKs and embed codes.
bayn: Bayer is a German pharmaceutical and agrochemical group based in Leverkusen, founded in 1863. Known for aspirin, it makes prescription and consumer medicines and, since buying Monsanto in 2018, seeds and crop-protection products such as Roundup.
bbca: Bank Central Asia (BCA) is Indonesia's largest private bank, based in Jakarta and founded in 1957. It is known for everyday banking and payments — current and savings accounts, the BCA mobile app, cards and a huge network of ATMs — and it is controlled by the Hartono family's Djarum group.
bbdc4: Bradesco is one of Brazil's largest private banks, based in Osasco, São Paulo state, and founded in 1943. It offers retail and corporate banking and, through Bradesco Seguros, runs one of the country's leading insurance groups.
bbri: Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI) is a state-owned Indonesian bank from Jakarta whose history goes back to 1895. It specialises in microloans and small businesses and has a huge network of branches and agents in villages across the archipelago.
bbt: BabyBoomToken (BBT), launched in March 2023, is a blockchain-based reward system that aims to address falling birth rates by rewarding family-related milestones such as pregnancy, childbirth and child-rearing with tokens.
bbva: BBVA is Spain's second-largest bank, headquartered in Bilbao and Madrid. The group's biggest business is Mexico's BBVA México; it also controls Turkey's Garanti BBVA, operates in South America and is known for its advanced digital banking.
bby: Best Buy is the largest consumer electronics retailer in the US, based in Minnesota and founded in 1966. It sells laptops, smartphones, TVs, appliances and games in stores and online, and its Geek Squad service installs and repairs devices.
bc-token: BC is the native token of BC.GAME, an online crypto casino and betting platform. Built on Solana, it serves as the platform's utility and governance token, used for rewards, incentives and in-platform features.
bce: BCE is Canada's largest telecommunications company, based in Montreal and the parent of Bell Canada. It provides mobile, internet and TV services and owns Bell Media, which includes the CTV television network.
bch: Bitcoin Cash is a cryptocurrency that split off from bitcoin in a 2017 hard fork. Its supporters raised the block size so the network can handle more transactions with lower fees, promoting BCH as digital cash for everyday payments.
bdca: BitDCA is a project with the Littlebit mobile app, which automatically sets aside a small percentage of every regular card purchase in bitcoin. BDCA token holders receive a share of transaction revenue; the service is aimed mainly at Europe.
bdx: Becton Dickinson (BD) is a US medical supplies maker based in Franklin Lakes, New Jersey, founded in 1897. It is one of the world's largest makers of syringes and needles and also produces blood-collection systems, infusion pumps and diagnostic equipment.
bdx-token: Beldex is a privacy cryptocurrency and ecosystem launched in 2018. The BDX coin enables private transfers, and the project builds data-protection tools including the BChat messenger, a browser and a private VPN.
be: Bloom Energy is a US energy company from San Jose, California, founded in 2001 by K. R. Sridhar. It makes Bloom Energy Server solid oxide fuel cells that generate electricity on site for factories, hospitals and data centers.
beam: Beam is a blockchain gaming ecosystem that grew out of the Merit Circle gaming guild and runs as its own network on Avalanche. It gives game studios infrastructure for games, NFTs and other digital products; BEAM is the native token used for transaction fees in the network.
bear: TEDDY BEAR (BEAR) is a PRC-20 meme coin on PulseChain, the blockchain founded by Richard Heart. It pays tribute to the teddy bear that became a familiar sight in the crypto community thanks to his livestreams.
bei: Beiersdorf is a German consumer goods company based in Hamburg, founded in 1882. It makes skin and body care products under brands such as NIVEA, Eucerin and La Prairie, and adhesive tapes and bonding solutions under the tesa brand.
bel: Bharat Electronics (BEL) is India's state-owned defense electronics company from Bengaluru, founded in 1954. It makes radars, communication systems, air defense systems, electronic warfare equipment and electronic voting machines.
bel-token: Bella Protocol (BEL) is a DeFi platform that aims to make earning yield on crypto as simple as a one-click savings product, packaging automated strategies into easy-to-use vaults. BEL is its governance and reward token.
believe: Believe is a token-launch platform on Solana, formerly known as Clout and founded by Ben Pasternak. Anyone can create a token for a startup or idea simply by posting on social media, and BELIEVE is the platform's token.
bells: Bellscoin (BELLS) is a proof-of-work cryptocurrency created in 2013 by Billy Markus, shortly before he co-created Dogecoin. Long dormant, it was revived by its community and now also supports inscriptions similar to Bitcoin Ordinals.
bem: BEM is the first example token of the TapeOut protocol on Ethereum, where developers wire basic logic components into circuits and publish them as on-chain NFTs anyone can run and verify. BEM is mined through "Proof of Design" with a fixed 21 million supply.
ben: Franklin Resources, which operates as Franklin Templeton, is a US asset manager based in San Mateo, California, founded in 1947. It runs mutual funds, ETFs and investment strategies in stocks, bonds and alternatives for individual and institutional investors, and bought Legg Mason in 2020.
bera: Berachain (BERA) is an EVM-compatible layer-1 blockchain using a Proof of Liquidity mechanism, which grew out of the community around the Bong Bears NFT collection. BERA is the gas token used to pay fees, while a separate token, BGT, handles governance and rewards.
bert: Bertram The Pomeranian (BERT) is a memecoin inspired by Bertram, a real Pomeranian dog with a large online fan following. The project says its mission is to help dogs around the world, linking the meme with AI tools and smart dog tags.
bfc: Bifrost (BFC) is a South Korean blockchain project building a multichain network and bridges for decentralized apps that run across different blockchains. The BFC token pays for network services and is used for staking.
bfusd: BFUSD is a reward-bearing margin asset created by Binance for its futures traders, launched in 2024. Users swap USDT for BFUSD, use it as collateral for futures positions and receive daily rewards generated by Binance's yield strategies; it is not an independent on-chain stablecoin.
bg: Bunge is one of the world's largest agribusiness and food companies, founded in Amsterdam in 1818 and now based in St. Louis. It buys, stores and processes soybeans, rapeseed, sunflower and other oilseeds into oils and meal, mills grain, and merged with Viterra in 2025.
bgsc: BugsCoin (BGSC) is a reward token on BNB Smart Chain. It replaces closed loyalty-point systems: users earn it for activity in partner apps and services and can spend or trade it, with transactions and rewards recorded transparently on the blockchain.
bhartiartl: Bharti Airtel is an Indian telecom operator based in New Delhi, founded by Sunil Mittal in 1995. One of the world's largest mobile operators, it works in India and many African countries (Airtel Africa) and also provides broadband and TV.
bhp: BHP is an Australian mining company based in Melbourne, one of the largest in the world, with a history dating back to 1885. It mines iron ore, copper and metallurgical coal and is developing a potash project in Canada.
bico: Biconomy is Web3 infrastructure that makes blockchain apps easier to use: through its APIs and SDKs developers add smart accounts, gasless transactions where the app pays fees, and simple sign-in without complex wallet setup. BICO is used for its relayer network and governance.
bifi: Beefy is a multi-chain yield optimizer launched in 2020: users deposit tokens into vaults that automatically reinvest farming rewards to compound returns. BIFI is the governance token and earns a share of the platform's fees.
big5on: Ondo Big 5 Core Allocation Portfolio (BIG5ON) is a tokenized investment product from Ondo Global Markets, the Ondo Finance platform that offers blockchain tokens tracking US securities to investors outside the United States. The token gives onchain exposure to a ready-made portfolio instead of a single stock.
bigtime: Big Time is a multiplayer online time-travel RPG from Big Time Studios, led by Decentraland co-founder Ari Meilich. While playing, gamers can earn BIGTIME tokens and NFT items.
biib: Biogen is an American biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 1978 and one of the oldest biotech firms. It focuses on brain and nerve diseases, with medicines for multiple sclerosis such as Tysabri, spinal muscular atrophy (Spinraza) and, together with Eisai, the Alzheimer's drug Leqembi.
bill-token: Billions Network is a network for verifying humans and AI agents: it confirms that a user is a unique real person via their mobile phone without revealing personal data. The BILL token is used for rewards and to run the network.
bim: BIM is the token of BIM Finance, a decentralized finance (DeFi) project built natively on Base, the Ethereum layer-2 network launched by Coinbase. The token is used inside the project's DeFi services.
bimboa: Grupo Bimbo is a Mexican food company from Mexico City, founded in 1945, and the world's largest bakery. It makes bread, buns, cakes and snacks sold in dozens of countries under brands such as Bimbo, Marinela, Sara Lee, Thomas' and Entenmann's.
bio: Bio Protocol (BIO) is a decentralized science (DeSci) protocol that helps communities of patients and scientists fund biotech research and own the rights to it. The project was backed by Binance Labs, and BIO is used for governance and to support BioDAOs.
birb: Moonbirds (BIRB) is a token linked to the Moonbirds NFT collection of 10,000 pixel owls, launched in 2022 by Kevin Rose's PROOF team. The brand was later acquired by Orange Cap Games.
bitcoin: HarryPotterObamaSonic10Inu (ticker BITCOIN) is a memecoin on Ethereum launched in 2023. Its absurd name mixes Harry Potter, Barack Obama, Sonic and the Inu dog-coin trend as a joke, and it has no function beyond its community.
bkn: Brickken (BKN) is the token of Brickken, a Barcelona-based platform that helps companies tokenize real-world assets such as company shares, debt and real estate and offer them to investors. BKN is used for payments and rewards on the platform.
bkng: Booking Holdings is a US online travel company headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut. It owns Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK and OpenTable for booking accommodation, flights, rental cars and restaurant tables.
bkr: Baker Hughes is a US energy technology company from Houston whose history goes back to 1907. It supplies oil and gas companies with drilling and production equipment and services and also makes gas turbines, compressors and LNG equipment.
blend: Fluent is a blockchain for apps that depend on user reputation. Its Prints data layer gives developers verifiable reputation scores built from on-chain activity and contribution quality; the BLEND token powers the ecosystem.
bless: Bless Network (BLESS) is a San Francisco-based decentralized computing platform that turns the spare capacity of everyday devices such as laptops and phones into a shared global computer. Participants earn tokens for the computing power they provide.
blk: BlackRock is the world's largest investment manager, headquartered in New York and founded in 1988 by Larry Fink. It manages pension and investment money, issues ETFs under the iShares brand, including the bitcoin fund IBIT, and built the Aladdin risk-analytics platform.
blkdigon: BLKDIGon (Ondo Diversified Growth Powered by BlackRock) is a tokenized portfolio from Ondo Finance that gives on-chain exposure to a model allocation of roughly 70% stocks and 30% bonds and alternatives built from BlackRock funds, aiming for balanced, moderate-risk growth.
blkgrwon: Ondo High Growth Powered by BlackRock (BLKGRWON) is a tokenized investment portfolio from Ondo Finance aimed at long-term capital growth. It holds roughly 95% stocks through BlackRock's iShares equity strategies across US and international markets, plus about 5% in bitcoin.
blkhion: BLKHIon is a tokenized portfolio from Ondo Finance, «Ondo High Income Powered by BlackRock». The token gives exposure to a model mix of BlackRock iShares bond ETFs: flexible income, securitized debt, investment-grade and high-yield credit and short-duration bonds. Access restrictions apply.
blob: BLOB is a memecoin named after the "Big Blob of Compute" – the idea in artificial intelligence that progress comes mainly from scaling up computing power and data rather than clever tricks. It is a community token with no product of its own, so its price depends on hype.
bluai: Bluwhale (BLUAI) is a decentralized AI network where developers and companies deploy AI agents that provide financial insights and services to its users across several blockchains, including Sui, Arbitrum and Cardano. It is backed by UOB Venture Management and SBI Holdings; BLUAI, launched in October 2025, pays for gas, governance, staking and nodes.
blue: Bluefin is a decentralized exchange for perpetual futures and spot trading built on the Sui blockchain. It aims to feel like a centralized exchange while users keep control of their funds; BLUE is its governance and rewards token.
blur: Blur is an NFT marketplace and aggregator for professional traders on Ethereum, launched in 2022. It quickly became one of the market leaders thanks to zero trading fees and rewards for active traders; the BLUR token is used for governance.
blz: Bluzelle is a decentralized storage network founded in Singapore in 2017, later focused on storing data and NFTs for games and Web3 apps. BLZ is its token, used to pay for storage and to stake for securing the network.
bmed: Banca Mediolanum is an Italian bank based in Basiglio near Milan, founded by Ennio Doris. Instead of traditional branches it works through a network of financial advisers, offering accounts, mortgages, investment funds and insurance; the Berlusconi family's Fininvest is a major shareholder.
bmo: Bank of Montreal (BMO) is Canada's oldest bank, founded in 1817 in Montreal. It provides banking, investment and insurance services in Canada and has a large US network, especially in the Midwest.
