rad: Radworks is a community that develops Radicle, a decentralized peer-to-peer network for collaborating on code built on Git and an alternative to GitHub, and Drips, a way to fund open-source software. RAD is the governance token.
rageguy: Rage Guy (RAGEGUY) is a meme coin based on the famous angry "FFFUUU" face from the rage comics of the late 2000s internet. It has no product of its own: its value rests on community interest and trading.
rai: Rai Reflex Index (RAI) is a stable asset backed by ETH, created by Reflexer Labs. Unlike typical stablecoins it is not pegged to the dollar: an automated controller nudges its redemption price to dampen volatility.
rail: Railgun (RAIL) is a smart contract system for private transactions on Ethereum and other networks that uses zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs). It lets users trade and lend on DeFi platforms while hiding their balances and wallet history; RAIL is the governance token.
rain: Rain is a decentralised protocol for options and prediction markets on the Arbitrum network. Anyone can create a market on an event and trade it; public markets are settled by an AI oracle, while in private ones the creator decides the result.
rare: SuperRare is one of the first marketplaces for digital art as NFTs on Ethereum, launched in 2018. Artists sell unique works to collectors there, and the RARE token gives voting rights in the DAO and in running curated spaces.
rari: RARI is the governance token of Rarible, an NFT marketplace and toolkit launched in 2020 that lets creators mint and sell digital collectibles and lets other platforms build their own NFT stores. Holders vote in the Rarible DAO; the project also runs its own network, RARI Chain.
rave: RaveDAO (RAVE) is a global community that combines music, technology and charity by organizing electronic music events, the first of which took place in Dubai in 2024. The RAVE token is used for tickets and community participation.
ray: Raydium is an automated market maker (AMM) and decentralized exchange on Solana, launched in 2021. It lets users swap tokens, provide liquidity and launch new projects, and many Solana meme coins trade in Raydium pools.
rbnt: Redbelly Network (RBNT) is a formally verified blockchain developed at the University of Sydney together with CSIRO, Australia's national science agency. It is built for issuing and trading compliant tokenized real-world assets, with user identity checked at the transaction layer and personal data protected by zero-knowledge proofs.
rcl: Royal Caribbean Group is the world's second-largest cruise company, headquartered in Miami. It runs the Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises and Silversea brands and operates some of the largest passenger ships ever built.
rddt: Reddit is a US social platform based in San Francisco, founded in 2005 by Steve Huffman and Alexis Ohanian. It hosts thousands of topic communities called subreddits, where users post and vote on content, and earns money from advertising and licensing its data for AI.
rddt-token: Reddit • Robinhood Token is a tokenized version of Reddit shares issued by Robinhood for its customers in the European Union. It follows the price of the US-listed stock and can be traded around the clock on a blockchain.
re: Re (RE) is an online capital market for insurance that connects investors with fully collateralized reinsurance deals and brings them on-chain. Investors earn income from insurance premiums, which is only loosely linked to crypto market cycles.
react: Reactive Network (REACT) is the token of Reactive Network, an EVM-compatible blockchain built around reactive smart contracts. These contracts watch events on other chains and automatically run actions in response, without a user sending a transaction.
real: RealLink (REAL) is the token of a Web3 social-finance ecosystem that links content creation, social apps and crypto payments. It is connected to the video social app BuzzCast, the voice chat app Tada and the multi-chain payment gateway DPay.
recall: Recall (RECALL) is a decentralized network where AI agents compete in public, on-chain challenges such as trading, so their skills can be measured and ranked. The results build a verifiable reputation that helps people find agents worth trusting; RECALL is used for staking and rewards.
recruit: Recruit Holdings is a Tokyo-based Japanese company in the jobs and HR technology market. It owns the job sites Indeed and Glassdoor, and in Japan runs listings platforms, staffing agencies and booking services.
red: RedStone (RED) is a blockchain oracle that feeds asset prices into DeFi smart contracts. It specializes in yield-bearing assets such as liquid staking and restaking tokens that lending markets accept as collateral; RED is used for staking and security.
redo: Resistance Dog (REDO) is a community memecoin on the TON blockchain. It is inspired by the 'Resistance Dog', the dog image that became a symbol of Telegram users defending internet freedom; it has no function beyond trading and community.
reef: Reef (REEF) is the coin of Reef Chain, an EVM-compatible layer-1 blockchain built with Substrate, the Polkadot technology. It aims at fast, low-cost apps for DeFi, NFTs and games, and REEF pays fees and secures the network through staking.
regn: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals is a US biotech company from Tarrytown, New York, founded in 1988. It develops antibody-based medicines; its best known are Eylea for eye diseases and Dupixent for eczema and asthma, sold with Sanofi.
rei: Rei (REI) is the token of 0xReisearch, a team of AI and crypto developers researching how to bring neural networks onto blockchains, mainly Ethereum-compatible (EVM) chains, and building AI agents on that work.
rekt: Rekt (REKT) is a meme token linked to Rekt Brands, a Web3 brand spanning art, media, NFTs and physical goods. Its best-known projects are Rekt Drinks, a flavoured sparkling water marketed as the «official drink of web3», and the Rektguy NFT collection launched in 2022.
reliance: Reliance Industries is India's largest conglomerate, based in Mumbai, founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and led by Mukesh Ambani. It runs the world's largest oil refining complex in Jamnagar, the mobile operator Jio and the Reliance Retail chain.
ren: Ren is a project whose RenVM network let users move bitcoin and other coins onto Ethereum and other chains as wrapped tokens such as renBTC. Bought by Alameda Research in 2020, it wound down its original network after the FTX collapse in 2022; REN was used to stake darknodes that ran the system.
render: Render Network is a decentralized platform where owners of graphics cards rent out computing power for 3D rendering, visual effects and AI workloads. It grew out of Jules Urbach's company OTOY; RENDER is used to pay for GPU work.
rep: Repsol is a Spanish energy company based in Madrid. It produces oil and gas in the Americas and other regions, runs refineries and a network of fuel stations in Spain, sells electricity and gas, and is expanding renewables and synthetic fuels.
reppo: REPPO is the token of REPPO.AI, a platform that combines AI training data with prediction markets. Creators publish AI-made work such as apps, videos or images, other users vote on its quality in weekly rounds, and both sides share token rewards.
req: Request (REQ) is a network for decentralized invoices and payments, launched in 2017. Companies and freelancers issue and pay invoices in crypto with a transparent record on the blockchain; REQ tokens are burned when the network is used.
resolv: Resolv is a DeFi protocol that issues USR, a dollar stablecoin backed by crypto such as ETH and kept stable with offsetting short futures positions (a delta-neutral strategy). RESOLV is the protocol's governance token.
rez: Renzo (REZ) is a restaking protocol on Ethereum that works with EigenLayer: users receive the liquid token ezETH and earn extra yield for helping secure other networks. REZ is the governance token.
rf: Regions Financial is a US regional bank from Birmingham, Alabama. It serves individuals and businesses in the South and Midwest with accounts, loans, mortgages and wealth management.
rhea: RHEA Finance is a DeFi platform in the NEAR ecosystem formed by merging the Ref Finance decentralized exchange with the Burrow lending protocol. It offers token swaps, lending and margin trading; RHEA is the governance token.
rhm: Rheinmetall is Germany's largest defense company, based in Düsseldorf and founded in 1889. It produces artillery and tank ammunition, military vehicles such as the Boxer, Lynx and the gun of the Leopard 2 tank, air-defense systems and digital military equipment, and is expanding ammunition plants across Europe.
ri: Pernod Ricard is the world's second-largest wine and spirits maker, based in Paris and formed in 1975 by the merger of Pernod and Ricard. Its brands include Absolut, Jameson, Chivas Regal, Havana Club, Martell, Malibu and Mumm champagne.
rice: Rice is the staple food of more than half of humanity. The Chicago exchange trades rough (unhusked) rice; prices depend on Asian harvests and export restrictions.
rice-token: Rice AI (RICE) is a decentralized AI project focused on robotics, aiming to train general-purpose AI for robots with data from a community network. It is backed by Rice Robotics, a Hong Kong company whose service robots are deployed in many countries.
rif: RIF (Rootstock Infrastructure Framework) is the infrastructure token of Rootstock, a smart-contract network that runs alongside Bitcoin and is secured by its miners. RIF encourages DeFi app development on Rootstock and is used across ecosystem services.
rio-au: Rio Tinto is a British-Australian mining company founded in 1873 to work mines in Spain; these shares trade on the Sydney exchange. It mines iron ore in Australia as well as copper, aluminium and lithium.
rio-token: Realio Network is a platform for issuing and trading tokenized real-world assets such as real estate and private equity, built on its own proof-of-stake blockchain. RIO is the network's native token used for staking, fees and governance.
ritual: Ritual (RITUAL) is a project building a blockchain on which smart contracts can call AI models directly. Its Infernet network connects on-chain applications with AI computation running off-chain.
riv: RIV Coin (RIV) is a governance token on the Solana blockchain. Holders can vote on decisions about the project's development, and the token is tied to the RIV Capital community.
river: River (RIVER) is a chain-abstraction stablecoin system: users lock collateral on one blockchain and receive the satUSD stablecoin and yield on others, without bridges. RIVER is the ecosystem's token.
riyad-bank: Riyad Bank is one of Saudi Arabia's largest banks, headquartered in Riyadh and founded in 1957. It serves corporations, government-linked projects and individual customers with loans, deposits, investment and brokerage services, and is expanding its digital banking.
rize: RIZE is the token of T-RIZE, a platform for compliant tokenization of real-world assets. Asset owners turn projects into tokens, investors buy fractional stakes through regulated distributors, and a privacy-preserving machine-learning layer helps with due diligence and valuation.
rjf: Raymond James Financial is an American financial company from St. Petersburg, Florida, founded in 1962. It offers wealth management through a network of financial advisors, investment banking and banking products.
rklb: Rocket Lab is a space company founded in New Zealand in 2006 by Peter Beck and now headquartered in Long Beach, California. It launches small satellites with its Electron rocket, is developing the larger reusable Neutron rocket, and builds spacecraft and parts such as solar panels and reaction wheels for other missions.
rl: Ralph Lauren is a New York fashion house founded in 1967 by designer Ralph Lauren. It sells clothing, accessories and home goods; its best-known symbol is the polo shirt with the logo of a player on horseback.
rlc: iExec RLC is a French decentralized computing project from Lyon, founded in 2016. It lets developers build apps that process private data inside protected environments, and the RLC token pays for computing power and data.
rls: Rayls is a blockchain platform for banks and financial institutions, developed by the Brazilian company Parfin. It combines private networks for institutions with an EVM-compatible public chain, so tokenized assets can move while keeping data confidential. RLS is its token.
rlusd: Ripple USD (RLUSD) is a dollar-pegged stablecoin launched by Ripple in December 2024. It is issued under a New York trust charter, backed by dollar deposits, short-term US Treasuries and cash equivalents, and runs on both the XRP Ledger and Ethereum, mainly for payments and institutional use.
rmd: ResMed is an American-Australian company from San Diego that makes CPAP machines and masks for treating sleep apnea and other breathing disorders. Its devices connect to the cloud, so doctors can monitor patients' therapy remotely.
rms: Hermès is a Paris-based French luxury house founded in 1837 as a harness workshop. Today it makes the iconic Birkin and Kelly bags, silk scarves, clothing, perfumes and watches; the founder's family still holds control.
rnbw: RNBW is the token of Rainbow, a popular self-custody crypto wallet app for Ethereum and its layer 2 networks, known for its colourful, beginner-friendly design. The token rewards users and gives them a say in the project.
rnt: RNT is the utility token of Reental, a Spanish platform that lets people invest in real estate through blockchain tokens representing shares in properties. The token is used within Reental's platforms.
roa: ROACORE (ROA) is a Web3 ecosystem on Solana that turns everyday activity such as walking, cultural events and digital engagement into rewards. It includes the DOGDOG, MODA Gallery and ROA STORE apps, and ROA is the ecosystem's token.
roam: ROAM is a decentralized wireless (DePIN) network that aims to give users free, seamless WiFi roaming worldwide using the OpenRoaming standard. People who share hotspots or check in to networks earn rewards; ROAM is the network's token.
robo: Fabric Protocol (ROBO) is an open global network, backed by the non-profit Fabric Foundation, for building, governing and improving general-purpose robots together. A public ledger with verifiable computing coordinates the data, computation and rules that robots and the people working with them rely on.
rok: Rockwell Automation is an American industrial automation company based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with roots going back to 1903. Through its Allen-Bradley brand and FactoryTalk software it supplies controllers, motor drives, sensors and software that run production lines in factories, from cars to food and pharmaceuticals.
rol: Rollins is a US pest-control company based in Atlanta that owns Orkin, one of America's best-known pest-control brands, along with other services. It protects homes and businesses in many countries from termites, rodents, insects and wildlife.
roll: RollX is a decentralised trading platform native to Base that aims to offer exchange-level speed while keeping DeFi principles: transparency, self-custody and composability. ROLL is the platform's token.
ron: Ronin (RON) is a gaming blockchain created by Vietnamese studio Sky Mavis for the game Axie Infinity. It offers cheap, fast transactions for in-game economies and NFTs, and RON is used to pay fees and for staking.
rop: Roper Technologies is a US conglomerate from Sarasota, Florida, that grew from a pump maker into an owner of niche software companies. It buys and develops vertical software for healthcare, insurance, education, transportation and construction.
rosa: Rosa Inu (ROSA) is a meme coin. Like most meme coins, it is not backed by a business or assets, and its price is driven mainly by community attention and trading.
rose: Oasis Network (ROSE) is a layer-1 blockchain for confidential applications, founded by Berkeley professor Dawn Song. Its key network, Sapphire, is an EVM-compatible environment where smart contracts can work with private data; ROSE pays for fees and staking.
rost: Ross Stores is a US off-price retail chain based in Dublin, California. Through its Ross Dress for Less and dd's DISCOUNTS stores it sells branded clothing, shoes and home goods at discounts to regular department-store prices.
rpl: Rocket Pool (RPL) is a decentralized liquid staking protocol for Ethereum, founded in Australia. Users can stake from 0.01 ETH and receive the rETH token, while node operators lock up RPL as extra collateral that guarantees honest behaviour.
rsc: ResearchCoin (RSC) is the token of ResearchHub, an open-science platform co-founded by Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong. It rewards scientists for publishing, peer-reviewing and discussing research.
rsg: Republic Services is the second-largest waste management company in the United States, based in Phoenix, Arizona. It collects household and business trash, sorts recyclables and runs landfills, serving millions of customers across the country.
rsr: Reserve Rights (RSR) is the token of the Reserve protocol, where anyone can issue a stablecoin or index token backed by a basket of assets. RSR insures these tokens: it is staked as extra collateral in case the reserve loses value, and it is also used for governance.
rtx: RTX (formerly Raytheon Technologies) is a US aerospace and defense company based in Arlington, Virginia. It combines jet engine maker Pratt & Whitney, avionics supplier Collins Aerospace and Raytheon, which builds missiles and Patriot air-defense systems.
ruji: Rujira (RUJI) is an app layer on THORChain that brings swaps, perpetual futures, lending and liquidations together in one interface. Users work with native coins such as real Bitcoin straight from their own wallet, without third-party bridges or wrapped tokens.
rune: THORChain is a decentralized cross-chain exchange that lets users swap native coins between blockchains, such as real Bitcoin for ETH, without bridges or wrapped tokens. RUNE is the base asset of its liquidity pools and is bonded by node operators to secure the network.
rvn: Ravencoin is a cryptocurrency launched in 2018 as a fork of Bitcoin, with no ICO and no premine. It specialises in issuing and transferring digital assets and is mined using the KAWPOW algorithm.
rvty: Revvity is a US life-science and diagnostics company from Waltham, Massachusetts, formed in 2023 from the former PerkinElmer's health sciences businesses. It sells lab instruments, reagents, software and newborn and disease screening tests to researchers, drugmakers and hospitals.
rwe: RWE is a German energy company from Essen, founded in 1898. It is one of the world's leaders in wind and solar power and also runs gas-fired power plants and trades energy.
ry: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) is Canada's largest bank, headquartered in Toronto and founded in 1864 in Halifax. It serves individuals and businesses and runs wealth management, insurance and investment banking in Canada, the US and other countries.
ryft: RYFT is the token of a platform on Robinhood Chain that combines an AI engine turning text prompts into playable single- and multiplayer games with a launchpad, so creators can release a token tied to each game.
s: Sonic (S) is an Ethereum-compatible (EVM) layer-1 blockchain that grew out of the Fantom network, whose FTM tokens were swapped for S. It focuses on fast, cheap transactions for DeFi and gives part of the fees back to app developers.
sab: Banco Sabadell is one of Spain's largest banks, founded in 1881 in Sabadell near Barcelona. It serves individuals and businesses in Spain and Mexico; in 2025 a hostile takeover bid by BBVA failed after too few shareholders accepted it.
sabic: SABIC (Saudi Basic Industries Corporation) is one of the world's largest petrochemical companies, based in Riyadh and founded in 1976. It makes plastics such as polyethylene and polypropylene, industrial chemicals, specialty materials and, through SABIC Agri-Nutrients, fertilizers; Saudi Aramco owns 70% of it.
saf: Safran is a French aerospace and defence company based in Paris. Through CFM, its joint venture with GE, it makes the popular LEAP jet engines for the Airbus A320neo and Boeing 737 MAX, as well as landing gear, brakes, cabin interiors and navigation systems.
safe: Safe (SAFE), formerly Gnosis Safe, is the standard for multisignature wallets on Ethereum and other chains, where a transfer needs approval from several keys. DAOs, funds and companies use it to hold assets; SAFE is the ecosystem's governance token.
saga: Saga (SAGA) is a layer-1 protocol that lets developers launch their own dedicated blockchains, called Chainlets, in a few clicks — popular with games and entertainment apps. Co-founded by Rebecca Liao, it uses SAGA for staking and fees.
sahara: Sahara AI is a blockchain platform for decentralized AI development where anyone can build, contribute data or models and earn from it. It combines its own blockchain, a marketplace for datasets and AI agents; the SAHARA token is used for payments and governance.
samo: Samoyedcoin (SAMO) is a dog-themed community memecoin on the Solana blockchain, launched in 2021 and named after the fluffy white Samoyed breed. It has no business behind it; its community promotes itself as an ambassador for Solana and has run events and charity campaigns.
samsung-biologics: Samsung Biologics is a South Korean biopharmaceutical company from Incheon, founded in 2011 within the Samsung group. It is one of the world's largest contract manufacturers of biologic drugs (CDMO), producing antibodies and other biologics for drugmakers.
samsung-c-t: Samsung C&T is a South Korean company from Seoul and the de facto holding company of the Samsung group, with roots dating to 1938. It works in construction (it built the Burj Khalifa), trading, fashion and resorts (Everland) and holds stakes in Samsung Electronics and Samsung Biologics.
samsung-electronics: Samsung Electronics is a South Korean technology giant based in Suwon, founded in 1969. It is the world's largest maker of memory chips and a leader in Galaxy smartphones, TVs and home appliances, and it also makes chips for other companies.
samsung-life: Samsung Life Insurance is South Korea's largest life insurer, headquartered in Seoul and founded in 1957. It offers life, health, retirement and savings products and owns a stake in Samsung Electronics.
samsung-sdi: Samsung SDI is a South Korean maker of batteries and electronic materials from Yongin, part of the Samsung group. It produces batteries for electric cars, including BMW models, energy storage systems and power tools.
san: Sanofi is a French pharmaceutical company based in Paris and one of the largest in the world. It makes medicines for immunology, rare diseases and cancer, including the blockbuster Dupixent, and is one of the world's leading vaccine makers.
san-es: Banco Santander is Spain's largest bank and one of Europe's biggest, founded in 1857 in the city of Santander. It operates in Spain, the United Kingdom, Brazil, Mexico, the United States and other countries, serves well over a hundred million customers and runs a large car-finance business, Santander Consumer.
sanc: Sanctum is liquid staking infrastructure on Solana. It lets any validator or project issue its own staked-SOL token and swap such tokens with one another instantly through a shared liquidity pool called Infinity.
sand: The Sandbox (SAND) is a virtual game world on Ethereum where players buy plots of LAND as NFTs and build games and spaces from voxel objects on them. The platform is developed with backing from Animoca Brands; SAND is used for purchases, staking and voting.
santos: Santos FC Fan Token (SANTOS) is the official fan token of Santos FC, the Brazilian football club famous as Pelé's team, issued on Binance's fan token platform. Holders can vote in club polls and get access to fan rewards and experiences.
sap: SAP is a German software company based in Walldorf, founded in 1972 by former IBM engineers. Europe's largest software maker, its ERP systems such as S/4HANA run finance, purchasing and production at large companies worldwide.
sap-de: SAP is Europe's largest software company, based in Walldorf, Germany, and founded in 1972 by former IBM engineers. It builds ERP systems for managing finance, purchasing, production and staff, used by most of the world's large companies.
sapien: Sapien is an AI company building Proof of Quality (PoQ), a system for evaluating AI work: data, reasoning, answers and actions. Network participants complete and review data-labeling tasks for rewards in the SAPIEN token.
sats: SATS (Ordinals) is a BRC-20 meme token on the Bitcoin network, named after the satoshi, the smallest unit of bitcoin. It was one of the first popular tokens issued through the Ordinals protocol.
sauce: SaucerSwap (SAUCE) is the leading decentralized exchange on the Hedera network, built from non-upgradable smart contracts with a focus on self-custody. Version 1 is a classic automated market maker and version 2 adds concentrated liquidity; Hedera's fair transaction ordering protects traders from front-running.
saudi-aramco: Saudi Aramco is Saudi Arabia's state oil company, based in Dhahran, and the world's largest oil exporter. It produces oil and gas (including at the giant Ghawar field) and owns refineries and chemical plants; part of its shares were listed in 2019.
saudi-awwal-bank: Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB) is a Saudi bank based in Riyadh, formerly known as SABB (Saudi British Bank), with HSBC as a major shareholder. It merged with Alawwal Bank in 2019 and took its current name in 2023; it is strong in corporate banking and trade finance.
saudi-electricity: Saudi Electricity Company is Saudi Arabia's main power utility, headquartered in Riyadh and formed in 2000 by merging regional electricity firms. It generates, transmits and distributes electricity to homes and businesses across the Kingdom and is largely state-owned.
saudi-national-bank: Saudi National Bank (SNB) is Saudi Arabia's largest bank, formed in 2021 by merging National Commercial Bank and Samba. Its largest shareholder is the state fund PIF, and it serves the government, corporations and millions of retail customers.
sbac: SBA Communications is a US real estate investment trust (REIT) based in Boca Raton, Florida, founded in 1989. It owns tens of thousands of wireless towers in the Americas and beyond and leases space on them to mobile carriers for their antennas.
sbc: Stable Coin (SBC) is a payments-focused stablecoin pegged to the US dollar, issued by Brale in partnership with Stable Coin Inc. It emphasizes redeemability and regulatory compliance and comes with developer tools for gasless transactions.
sbd: Steem Dollars (SBD) is a token of the Steem blockchain, launched in 2016 for the social blogging site Steemit. It was designed to track roughly one US dollar's worth of STEEM and is paid to authors and curators as part of their rewards.
sbin: State Bank of India (SBI) is India's largest bank, based in Mumbai and controlled by the state, with roots going back to 1806. It has tens of thousands of branches and offers retail, corporate, insurance and investment services to hundreds of millions of customers.
sbsp3: Sabesp is Brazil's largest water and sewage company, based in São Paulo and founded in 1973. It supplies drinking water and collects and treats wastewater for millions of people in hundreds of municipalities in São Paulo state; it was privatized in 2024.
sbux: Starbucks is the world's largest coffeehouse chain, founded in Seattle in 1971. It sells coffee, drinks and food in tens of thousands of cafés and coffee for home in grocery stores; Howard Schultz is famous for growing the chain.
sc: Siacoin (SC) is the token of Sia, a decentralized cloud storage network launched in 2015. Users rent disk space from independent hosts around the world, files are encrypted and spread across many nodes, and storage is paid for in SC.
schd: Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity (SCHD) holds US companies with stable and growing dividends. It is popular with people building passive income.
schg: Schwab U.S. Large-Cap Growth (SCHG) holds large US growth companies at a very low fee, with a heavy tilt towards technology.
schw: Charles Schwab is one of the largest US brokers and wealth managers, founded by Charles Schwab in 1971 and now headquartered in Texas. It offers commission-free stock trading, banking and retirement accounts, and it bought TD Ameritrade in 2020.
scmn: Swisscom is Switzerland's largest telecom operator, headquartered in Bern, with the state holding a controlling stake. It provides mobile, internet and TV services and also operates in Italy through its subsidiary Fastweb.
scor: Scor (SCOR) is the token of an on-chain sports engagement protocol. Fans get a permanent on-chain identity (SCOR-ID) that records their activity and skill, while licensed teams, leagues and athletes use the platform to power games, collectibles and competitions.
scr: Scroll is a layer-2 network for Ethereum built on zkEVM technology and compatible with Ethereum at the bytecode level, so apps move over without changes. It uses zero-knowledge proofs to make transactions cheaper; SCR is the governance token.
scrt: Secret Network is a privacy-focused blockchain built with the Cosmos SDK whose smart contracts can process encrypted data, so inputs and balances stay hidden from the public. It grew out of the Enigma project and uses trusted hardware for privacy; SCRT pays fees and secures the network through staking.
scs: Solcasino Token (SCS) is the token of Solcasino, an online crypto casino built around the Solana blockchain. Holders can receive a share of the platform's revenue and rewards; like all gambling, it carries a high risk of loss.
sd: Stader (SD) is a liquid staking platform: users stake coins such as Ether through it and receive a token like ETHx that keeps earning staking rewards while staying usable in DeFi. Stader works on several networks, and node operators use SD as collateral; SD is also its governance token.
sdex: SmarDex (SDEX) is a decentralized exchange designed to reduce impermanent loss, the main risk for people who provide liquidity to trading pools. It runs on Ethereum and several other networks; SDEX is used for staking, rewards and governance.
sdt: Stake DAO (SDT) is the governance token of Stake DAO, a DeFi platform that offers liquid lockers and yield strategies for governance tokens such as Curve's CRV. Users earn rewards while keeping a tradable token, and SDT holders steer the protocol.
sect: Sectora (SECT) is the token of a Layer 3 blockchain designed for verifying, holding and trading tokenized real-world assets, with custody, attestation and settlement built into the network itself. SECT is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum.
seda: SEDA is a modular data network that delivers and queries any type of data for smart contracts on many blockchains, acting as a programmable oracle layer. The SEDA token is used for staking and paying for data requests.
sei: Sei is an Ethereum-compatible (EVM) layer-1 blockchain that uses parallel transaction execution for high speed. The network focuses mainly on trading, DeFi and games; SEI pays for fees and staking.
sent: Sentient is an open-source AI project building a community network of open models, agents and data as an alternative to closed AI labs. Through the Sentient GRID, partners combine models and computing power, and contributors are rewarded; SENT is the token at the core of the network's economy.
sentis: SentismAI (SENTIS) is an AI project on BNB Chain that offers autonomous agents to automate crypto trading, risk management, yield optimization and DAO governance across EVM-compatible networks.
serv: OpenServ is a platform for building and running AI agents that can work together across different frameworks and tasks in one shared environment. SERV is its token, used to pay for agent services and to reward developers who build agents on the platform.
seven-i: Seven & i Holdings is a Japanese retail group from Tokyo and the owner of 7-Eleven, the world's largest convenience store chain. It runs tens of thousands of 7-Eleven stores in Japan, the United States and other countries.
sfi: saffron.finance (SFI) is a DeFi protocol on Ethereum that splits yield from lending and liquidity pools into risk tranches: one tranche gets steadier returns with protection, another takes more risk for higher potential yield. SFI is its governance token.
sfp: SafePal (SFP) is a crypto wallet with hardware, mobile and browser-extension versions, backed by Binance Labs. It lets users store, swap and buy cryptocurrencies across many blockchains; the SFP token gives discounts and access to wallet features.
sgb: Songbird (SGB) is the canary network of the Flare blockchain, launched in 2021, where new features are tested under real conditions before reaching Flare. It runs decentralized price feeds for smart contracts; SGB pays fees and is used for delegation and governance.
sgo: Saint-Gobain is a French building-materials group based near Paris, founded in 1665 as a royal glassworks that supplied the mirrors of Versailles. Today it makes glass, insulation, plasterboard, mortars and other materials for construction and renovation under brands such as Isover, Placo/Gyproc and Weber.
share: ShareX (SHARE) is Web3 infrastructure for the sharing economy that puts devices such as charging stations and vending machines, along with their usage and revenue data, on the blockchain. This lets income from real-world devices be turned into tokenized assets.
shdw: Shadow Token (SHDW) is the token of Shadow Drive, a decentralized storage network for the Solana ecosystem developed by GenesysGo. Users pay in SHDW to store files, and node operators earn it for providing storage.
shell: MyShell is a platform where anyone can create, share and own AI agents and chatbots without coding. The project develops open-source AI models, such as voice cloning, and the SHELL token is used for payments, creator rewards and governance.
shfl: SHFL is the native utility token of Shuffle.com, an online crypto casino and sports-betting platform. It is used for betting on the platform, in its token lottery and for rewards programmes for active users.
shib: Shiba Inu is a meme coin featuring the Shiba Inu dog, launched in 2020 by an anonymous founder known as Ryoshi as a "Dogecoin killer". The token runs on Ethereum, and its ecosystem includes the ShibaSwap exchange and its own layer-2 network, Shibarium.
shin-etsu-chemical: Shin-Etsu Chemical is a Japanese chemical company based in Tokyo, founded in 1926. It is the world's largest maker of silicon wafers for chips and of PVC, and also produces silicones, photoresists and rare-earth magnets.
shinhan-financial: Shinhan Financial Group is a South Korean financial group from Seoul and the parent of Shinhan Bank, founded in 1982. It offers banking, credit cards, insurance, brokerage and asset management in Korea and Asia.
shl: Siemens Healthineers is a German medical technology company from Erlangen and the healthcare arm of Siemens. It makes MRI, CT and X-ray machines and lab diagnostics and, after buying Varian, radiation therapy equipment for cancer treatment.
shop: Shopify is a Canadian technology company from Ottawa, founded in 2006 by Tobi Lütke. Its platform lets anyone open an online store, accept payments, manage inventory and sell through social media and in physical shops.
shop-etf: Shopify is a Canadian technology company from Ottawa, founded in 2006 by Tobi Lütke. Its platform lets anyone open an online store, accept payments, manage inventory and sell through social media and in physical shops.
shopinx: ShopinX (SHOPINX) is a crypto project on BNB Chain aimed at business services and marketing. It builds blockchain-based tools for online shops and promotion, and SHOPINX is its token.
shr: ShareToken (SHR) is the token of ShareRing, an Australian company building a digital identity app, ShareRing Me, that lets people store verified documents and share only the details a service needs. SHR pays for network services and transactions.
shw: Sherwin-Williams is the world's largest paint and coatings maker, founded in Cleveland, Ohio, in 1866. It sells paint through thousands of its own stores and under brands such as Valspar, Minwax and Krylon.
shx: Stronghold (SHX) is the token of Stronghold, a US financial platform offering APIs for dollar payments, trading and settlement. SHX runs on the Stellar network and is used across the platform's ecosystem, including for rewards and discounts.
si: Super Inu (SI) is a dog-themed meme coin on Solana, launched through the stonk.fun launchpad. It has no product of its own: its value rests on community interest and trading.
sie: Siemens is a German technology group based in Munich, founded in 1847 by Werner von Siemens. It makes factory automation equipment and industrial software, systems for buildings and power grids, and trains and rail signalling.
sign: Sign is a project building infrastructure for verifying data and distributing tokens: Sign Protocol for on-chain attestations and TokenTable for airdrops and vesting. The SIGN token is used in the ecosystem and for governance.
sika: Sika is a Swiss specialty chemicals company based in Baar, founded in 1910 by Kaspar Winkler. It makes construction chemicals such as waterproofing, sealants, adhesives, concrete admixtures and roofing, used in bridges, tunnels and skyscrapers.
silver: Silver is both a precious and an industrial metal, used in electronics, solar panels and medicine. Because of that dual demand, its price usually moves more sharply than gold's.
singularry: Singularry (SINGULARRY) is the token of an autonomous AI agent built on Meta's Llama 3.1 70B model, which posts and interacts on social media and uses memes and crypto as part of its experiment in self-improving AI.
sinopec: Sinopec (China Petroleum & Chemical) is a Chinese state-owned oil and chemicals company based in Beijing. It is China's largest oil refiner and petrochemical producer, owns the country's biggest network of filling stations and also produces oil and gas.
siren: Siren (SIREN) is an AI-themed memecoin on BNB Chain. It has no business or cash flow behind it: the token runs on community attention, and its price has already seen extreme surges and crashes driven by hype.
sis: Symbiosis (SIS) is the token of Symbiosis Finance, a cross-chain decentralized exchange that lets users swap tokens between many different blockchains in one step. SIS is used for governance and rewards for liquidity providers.
six: SIX Network (SIX) is the token of SIX Network, a blockchain company from Thailand that builds digital-asset infrastructure for businesses, such as NFTs, tokenized assets and payment tools. SIX is used for fees and staking on its chain.
sk-hynix: SK hynix is a South Korean memory chip maker based in Icheon and part of the SK Group. It produces DRAM and NAND flash memory and is a major supplier of HBM high-bandwidth memory used in AI accelerators, including Nvidia's.
skhy: This is a tokenized share that tracks SK Hynix, issued through Backpack Securities so it can be traded on crypto rails. SK Hynix is a South Korean memory chipmaker based in Icheon and part of the SK Group; it makes DRAM and NAND flash and is a leading supplier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI chips.
skl: SKALE is a network of Ethereum-compatible blockchains where each app can have its own chain with no gas fees for users. It is popular with blockchain games; SKL is used for validator staking and to pay for chains.
skr: Seeker (SKR) is the token of the Solana Mobile ecosystem tied to the Seeker smartphone, successor to the Saga. It supports a decentralized app store without middlemen and community governance, letting developers reach users directly.
sky: SKY is the governance token of Sky Protocol, the new name of MakerDAO, creator of the DAI stablecoin. After the 2024 rebrand the protocol issues the USDS stablecoin (an upgraded DAI), and SKY holders vote on the system's key settings.
skyai: SkyAI is an artificial intelligence project on BNB Chain building an ecosystem of AI tools around MCP (Model Context Protocol). It connects AI agents to blockchain data and outside services, and the SKYAI token is used within that ecosystem.
skyd: Skydance is an American media company founded by David Ellison in 2010. Its studio produced Mission: Impossible films and Top Gun: Maverick, and in 2025 it merged with Paramount, gaining the film studio, the CBS TV network and the Paramount+ streaming service.
slb: SLB (formerly Schlumberger) is the world's largest oilfield services company, founded in 1926 in France by the Schlumberger brothers. It provides technology and services for oil and gas exploration, drilling and production and is developing low-carbon energy solutions.
slc: Silencio is a DePIN project whose mobile app rewards users with SLC tokens for measuring noise levels around them and recording real voice data. The data helps map noise pollution and train AI to understand speech in many languages and accents.
slhn: Swiss Life is a Swiss insurer from Zurich, founded in 1857. It specializes in life insurance, pensions and asset management, especially real estate, and operates in Switzerland, France, Germany and other European countries.
slp: Smooth Love Potion (SLP) is the in-game token of Axie Infinity, made by the Vietnamese studio Sky Mavis. Players earn SLP in battles and spend it on breeding new Axie creatures.
slv: iShares Silver Trust (SLV) is a fund backed by physical silver — the simplest way to own silver through an ordinary brokerage account.
slv-token: iShares Silver Trust • Robinhood Token is a tokenized version of iShares Silver Trust (SLV) shares issued by Robinhood for its customers in the European Union. It follows the price of the US-listed stock and can be traded around the clock on a blockchain.
slx: Solstice is a DeFi protocol that brings institutional-grade yield products on-chain, such as stablecoin-based strategies, instead of leveraged bets on volatile assets. SLX is the protocol's token.
smc: SMC is a Japanese maker of pneumatic equipment from Tokyo, founded in 1959, and the world leader in pneumatic automation. It produces valves, cylinders, actuators and fittings used on automated production lines.
smci: Supermicro (Super Micro Computer) is a US server maker from San Jose, California, founded in 1993 by Charles Liang. It builds servers, storage and complete liquid-cooled rack systems for data centers, cloud providers and AI computing, often using Nvidia chips.
smh: VanEck Semiconductor (SMH) is an ETF holding the biggest chipmakers and chip-equipment companies, such as Nvidia, TSMC, Broadcom and AMD.
smic: SMIC (Semiconductor Manufacturing International) is mainland China's largest contract chipmaker, founded in 2000 in Shanghai. It manufactures chips designed by other companies and plays a key role in China's push for semiconductor self-reliance.
smic-cn: SMIC (A shares) are shares of Chinese contract chipmaker SMIC listed on Shanghai's STAR Market for tech companies. Founded in 2000, the company makes chips for Chinese and foreign designers and is the largest semiconductor foundry in mainland China.

sn17: 404—GEN (SN17) is subnet 17 of the Bittensor network, dedicated to generating 3D models from text prompts. Miners compete to produce the best 3D assets for games, design and virtual worlds, and the subnet's open tools make them available to creators.
sn18: Zeus (SN18) is the token of subnet 18 on Bittensor, a decentralized network where participants are paid in tokens for useful AI work. sn24: OMEGA Labs (SN24) is the alpha token of subnet 24 on Bittensor. The subnet collects a large open multimodal dataset of video, audio and text from across the internet to train AI models, and the alpha token rewards miners who contribute useful data.

swap: TrustSwap is a crypto company that offers smart-contract tools for token projects, best known for Team Finance, a service for locking liquidity and team tokens so investors can see they cannot be sold early. SWAP is its utility token.
swarm: SWARM ENGINE (SWARM) is an AI tool for traders that watches the market and new token launches around the clock and rates them by signals. The SWARM token is used within the project's ecosystem.
swarms: Swarms (SWARMS) is a token on Solana linked to Swarms, an open-source framework created by Kye Gomez for building systems in which many AI agents cooperate on complex tasks. The token is tied to the project's community and ecosystem.
swell: Swell is a liquid staking and restaking protocol for Ethereum: users deposit ETH and receive tokens such as swETH and rswETH that earn rewards while staying usable in DeFi. The project also runs Swellchain, its own layer-2; SWELL is the governance token.
swftc: SWFTCOIN (SWFTC) is the token of SWFT Blockchain, a service for fast cross-chain crypto swaps through the SWFT Wallet app and the SwftSwap service. It also powers the project's AI services, including the SWFTGPT assistant.
swk: Stanley Black & Decker is a US tool maker from New Britain, Connecticut, formed in 2010 when Stanley Works (founded 1843) merged with Black & Decker. It sells hand and power tools and outdoor equipment under brands such as DeWalt, Stanley, Craftsman and Black+Decker.
swks: Skyworks Solutions is a US maker of radio-frequency chips based in Irvine, California. Its amplifiers, filters and front-end modules handle wireless signals in smartphones, including the iPhone, as well as in Wi-Fi gear, cars and industrial devices.
sxp: Solar (SXP) is the coin of Solar Network, a community-run blockchain that uses delegated proof of stake. The project grew out of Swipe: SXP moved from Ethereum and BNB Chain to its own Solar mainnet, where holders vote for block producers.
sxt: Space and Time (SXT) is a blockchain database that gives smart contracts and AI verified data with a cryptographic proof that the query was correct (Proof of SQL). The project was backed by Microsoft's venture fund M12; SXT pays for queries and staking.
syf: Synchrony Financial is a US consumer lender based in Stamford, Connecticut, spun off from General Electric. It issues store and co-branded credit cards for retailers such as Amazon and Lowe's and finances healthcare purchases.
syk: Stryker is a US medical technology company based in Portage, Michigan, founded in 1941 by orthopedic surgeon Homer Stryker. It makes joint replacements, Mako surgical robots, surgical instruments and hospital beds.
symm: SYMMIO is a settlement layer for intent-based, peer-to-peer derivatives trading: other apps plug into it to offer perpetual futures, with trades matched between users and liquidity providers. SYMM is its token for governance and incentives.
syn: Synapse is a cross-chain protocol that connects layer-1 and layer-2 blockchains. Through its bridges users move assets and messages between networks without middlemen, and the SYN token is used for protocol governance.
synd: Syndicate (SYND) builds infrastructure for app-specific blockchains (appchains) in the Ethereum ecosystem, letting projects run their own chain with custom rules. SYND is the token of the Syndicate network.
syrup: Maple Finance (SYRUP) is an onchain lending platform that lends capital to institutional borrowers against collateral and offers depositors yield through syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT. The protocol was founded in Australia in 2019; SYRUP is its governance and staking token.
sys: Syscoin is a blockchain launched in 2014 that is merge-mined with bitcoin, so it shares bitcoin miners' security. On top it runs an Ethereum-compatible layer (NEVM) for smart contracts and supports rollups for cheaper transactions; SYS pays fees and rewards masternode operators.
syy: Sysco is the world's largest foodservice distributor, based in Houston, Texas, and founded in 1969. It delivers food, drinks, kitchen supplies and equipment to restaurants, hospitals, schools, hotels and other businesses that prepare meals away from home in the US and many other countries.
t: AT&T is one of the largest US telecom operators, headquartered in Dallas. It provides mobile service, home internet and fibre networks for consumers and businesses; its history goes back to the Bell Telephone Company founded in 1877.
t-token: Threshold Network (T) was formed in 2022 by merging the NuCypher and Keep networks. It develops threshold cryptography, and its best-known product is tBTC, a decentralized bitcoin token for use on Ethereum; T is used for node staking and governance.
t99: Tethereum (T99) is a decentralized finance token on BNB Chain. Despite the name, it is not related to Tether or to Ethereum: it is a separate project with its own community and apps.
ta: Trusta AI is an on-chain identity project that uses AI to tell real people apart from bots and AI agents. It is used to protect airdrops from Sybil attacks and to score wallet reputation; TA is the network's token.
tac: TAC is a layer-1 network that lets developers bring Ethereum-compatible (EVM) apps to the TON blockchain and Telegram's users, who can use them from TON wallets without bridging. TAC is the network's native token for fees and staking.
tag: TAGGER (TAG) is a decentralized data platform for AI where participants collect and label data for training models. The blockchain records authorship and rights to the data, and the platform lets it be sold as a commodity.
taiko: Taiko is a decentralized Ethereum layer-2 rollup that is fully Ethereum-equivalent (a Type-1 ZK-EVM), with block ordering handled by Ethereum's own validators. TAIKO is used for governance and securing the network.
take: OVERTAKE is a smart-contract platform for trading in-game assets that replaces risky peer-to-peer deals between players. It makes ownership of game items verifiable and safe to transfer; TAKE is the ecosystem token.
takeda: Takeda Pharmaceutical is Japan's largest drugmaker, founded in 1781 in Osaka. It develops medicines for gastroenterology, rare diseases, oncology and neuroscience as well as plasma-derived therapies, and acquired Ireland's Shire in 2019.
tao: Bittensor is a decentralised machine-learning network where participants compete to provide AI models and computing power in specialised 'subnets'. The best performers are rewarded in TAO, whose supply is capped at 21 million, like bitcoin's.
taobot: tao.bot (TAOBOT) is the token of an all-in-one Telegram bot for Bittensor, a trading and interaction terminal where users can trade TAO and Bittensor subnet tokens and manage their activity without leaving Telegram.
tatasteel: Tata Steel is an Indian steelmaker from Mumbai, founded in 1907 by Jamsetji Tata's group. One of the world's largest steel producers, it has plants in India (Jamshedpur), the Netherlands and the UK.
tbk: TronBank (TBK) is a DeFi protocol in the TRON ecosystem that helps users rent network energy and stake TRX to cut transaction fees. Its algorithms match energy supply and demand, and TBK is the protocol's token.
tcl: Transurban is an Australian company from Melbourne that builds and operates toll roads and tunnels. Its roads are in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane, as well as in North America.
tcs: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is India's largest IT services company, based in Mumbai and part of the Tata Group. Founded in 1968, it builds and runs software, cloud and consulting projects for banks, retailers and other large businesses around the world.
td: TD Bank (Toronto-Dominion Bank) is one of Canada's largest banks, based in Toronto and formed in 1955 by the merger of two banks. Besides Canada, it has a large branch network on the US East Coast under the TD Bank brand.
tdccp: TDCCP is a meme coin on Solana. Like most meme coins, it is not backed by a business or assets, and its price is driven mainly by community attention and trading.
tdg: TransDigm Group is a US maker of aircraft components based in Cleveland, Ohio. It buys and grows makers of highly specialised parts such as pumps, valves, sensors and seat belts for passenger and military aircraft.
tdrop: TDROP is the token of ThetaDrop, the NFT marketplace on the Theta blockchain known for digital collectibles from entertainment brands. Users earn TDROP for activity on the marketplace and use it for governance and rewards.
tdy: Teledyne Technologies is a US technology company based in Thousand Oaks, California. It makes FLIR thermal cameras, digital imaging sensors, scientific instruments, underwater drones and electronics for aerospace, space and defence.
tea: tea Protocol is a decentralized system for supporting open-source software: developers of open-source packages are rewarded according to how important their code is, and participants help check the security of the software supply chain. It was founded by Max Howell, creator of Homebrew.
team: Atlassian is an Australian software company founded in Sydney in 2002. It makes teamwork tools: the Jira issue and project tracker, the Confluence wiki and the Trello task boards.
techm: Tech Mahindra is an Indian IT services and consulting company based in Pune, part of the Mahindra Group, founded in 1986. It provides software development, telecom network services, consulting and business process outsourcing to clients worldwide.
tef: Telefónica is Spain's largest telecom operator, based in Madrid and founded in 1924. Under the Movistar, O2 and Vivo brands it provides mobile, broadband and TV services in Spain, Germany, Brazil and the UK, where it co-owns Virgin Media O2.
tel: TE Connectivity is a maker of connectors and sensors registered in Ireland with its main base in Switzerland, spun off from Tyco in 2007. Its components are used in cars, industrial equipment, data centres and medical devices.
ten: Tenaris is a global maker of steel pipes for the oil and gas industry and part of the Techint group of the Italian-Argentine Rocca family. Its plants in the Americas, Europe and Asia produce seamless and welded casing and tubing for wells and pipelines.
tencent: Tencent is a Chinese tech giant based in Shenzhen, founded in 1998 by Ma Huateng (Pony Ma). It owns the super-app WeChat and the WeChat Pay payment service, is the world's largest gaming company (Honor of Kings, stakes in Riot Games and Supercell) and runs cloud services.
ter: Teradyne is an American company based in North Reading, Massachusetts, founded in 1960. Its main business is automatic test equipment that chipmakers use to check semiconductors, including AI and smartphone chips, before they ship; it also makes collaborative robots through Universal Robots and mobile robots through MiR.
tet: Tectum (TET) is the coin of the Tectum blockchain, a high-speed Layer 1 network. Its best-known product is SoftNote, a system for instant, fee-free Bitcoin payments using digital banknotes.
tfc: Truist Financial is one of the largest US banks, headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, and formed in 2019 by merging BB&T and SunTrust. It serves individuals and businesses mainly in the southeastern US.
tfuel: Theta Fuel (TFUEL) is the operational token of the Theta network, used to pay for blockchain operations and to reward participants for relaying video streams and running computations on edge nodes. It works alongside THETA, which handles governance and security.
tgbp: Tokenised GBP (tGBP) is a stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the British pound and issued by a UK firm registered with the FCA. It is backed by cash and short-term UK Treasury bills and is used for on-chain payments in sterling.
tgc: TG.Casino is an online crypto casino that can also be played through Telegram. Its TGC token is tied to the platform through buy-backs: part of the casino's profits is used to buy TGC on the market.
tgt: Target is one of the largest US general-merchandise retailers, based in Minneapolis and founded in 1902. It sells clothing, home goods, groceries and electronics in its bullseye-logo stores and online.
that: THAT is a crypto payment project for everyday purchases. It pairs a non-custodial wallet with a directory of participating businesses, so users can pay for goods and services on-chain in seconds and send money peer-to-peer without banks or card networks.
the: Thena is a decentralized exchange and liquidity hub on BNB Chain, launched in 2023 with a ve(3,3) model: holders lock THE to vote on which pools receive rewards and earn a share of trading fees.
theros: THEROS is a Solana meme token launched in November 2025 around a gamified entertainment and learning platform about trading concepts. Its main feature is the on-chain Daily 4(X) Challenge; the supply is fixed and the mint authority was permanently revoked at launch.
theta: Theta Network is a blockchain for decentralized video delivery, media and AI computing. Participants share their computers' bandwidth and processing power and earn rewards; THETA is used for governance and staking, while a separate token, TFUEL, pays for operations.
thq: Theoriq (THQ) is the token of Theoriq, a protocol for AI agents that work together in groups to research and run decentralized finance (DeFi) strategies. THQ is used for staking and governance in the network.
tia: Celestia is a modular blockchain specializing in data availability: other networks publish their transaction data on it instead of storing everything themselves. This makes launching new blockchains and rollups easier; TIA pays for data and is used for staking.
tig: The Innovation Game (TIG) is a protocol that rewards people for creating and improving algorithms that solve hard computational challenges. Its proof-of-work style system pays TIG tokens to the best solutions and their inventors.
tina: TINA is a Geo-DePIN project that collects and verifies real-world map and mobility data. Participants share road and point-of-interest information through a mobile app and dashcam devices while driving, and can earn TINA tokens for their contributions.
titan: Titan Company is an Indian watch and jewelry maker from Bengaluru, a joint venture of the Tata Group. It owns the Tanishq jewelry chain, the Titan and Fastrack watch brands and Titan Eye+ optical stores.
tjx: TJX Companies is the world's largest off-price retailer of clothing and home goods, headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts. It runs the T.J. Maxx, Marshalls and HomeGoods chains in the US and TK Maxx in Europe and Australia.
tko: TKO Group Holdings is an American sports entertainment company formed in 2023 by merging UFC and WWE under Endeavor's control. It runs UFC mixed martial arts fights and WWE wrestling shows and sells their broadcast rights.
tko-token: Tokocrypto is a cryptocurrency exchange in Indonesia, founded in 2018 and acquired by Binance in 2022. TKO is its utility token, giving users fee discounts and access to platform features.
tlm: Alien Worlds is a blockchain game and NFT metaverse where players "mine" the in-game token Trilium (TLM) on virtual planets and vote on how they develop. It runs on WAX, Ethereum and BNB Chain and launched on Binance Launchpad.
tlos: Telos (TLOS) is a layer-1 blockchain launched in 2018, originally built on EOSIO technology and later extended with an Ethereum-compatible virtual machine. It offers fast, low-cost transactions; TLOS pays fees and is used for staking and governance.
tls: Telstra is Australia's largest telecommunications company, based in Melbourne. Formerly the state-owned Telecom Australia, it was privatized in stages from 1997 and now provides mobile, home internet and phone services, enterprise networks and international connectivity, running the country's biggest mobile network.
tlt: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond (TLT) holds long-term US government bonds maturing in more than 20 years. Its price reacts strongly to changes in interest rates.
tmo: Thermo Fisher Scientific is the world's largest supplier of equipment and services for science, headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It sells lab instruments, reagents and consumables and manufactures medicines under contract for drug companies.
tmus: T-Mobile US is an American mobile carrier based in Bellevue, Washington, controlled by Deutsche Telekom. After merging with Sprint in 2020 it became one of the largest US wireless operators and a leader in 5G coverage.
tnsr: Tensor is an NFT marketplace on Solana for professional traders, offering advanced trading tools, limit orders and bulk buying of collections. The team also developed a low-cost NFT standard on Solana; TNSR is the protocol's governance token.
token: TokenFi (TOKEN) is a tokenization platform launched by the team behind Floki. It lets anyone create crypto tokens without coding and aims to bring real-world assets on-chain; TOKEN runs on Ethereum and BNB Chain and is used for fees and staking.
tokio-marine: Tokio Marine Holdings is Japan's oldest and one of its largest insurance groups, founded in 1879. It offers property, auto and life insurance in Japan and abroad, including the US through Philadelphia Insurance and HCC.
tokyo-electron: Tokyo Electron is a Japanese maker of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, founded in Tokyo in 1963. It supplies tools for photoresist coating, etching, deposition and wafer cleaning to chipmakers such as TSMC, Samsung and Intel.
ton: Toncoin (TON) is the native coin of The Open Network blockchain, originally developed by the Telegram team led by the Durov brothers. The network is now deeply integrated into Telegram: a wallet, mini apps and payments inside the messenger.
tonic: Tectonic (TONIC) is the token of Tectonic, a decentralized lending and borrowing protocol on the Cronos blockchain. Users supply crypto to earn interest or borrow against collateral, and TONIC is used for rewards, staking and governance.
torch: TORCH is the token of Torch, a multi-chain trading and token-launch platform built on Robinhood Chain. It combines a fair-launch launchpad, a web trading terminal and a Telegram bot with one non-custodial wallet, and every trade on Torch buys back and burns the traded token.
torn: Tornado Cash is a decentralized privacy protocol on Ethereum that breaks the link between the sender's and recipient's wallets using zero-knowledge proofs. The US sanctioned it in 2022, and the sanctions were later lifted; TORN is the governance token.
toshi: Toshi (TOSHI) is a meme token on the Base network, named after the cat of Coinbase co-founder Brian Armstrong. The coin has become one of the symbols of Base's meme culture; it has no separate product and is driven by its community.
towns: Towns (TOWNS) is the token of Towns Protocol, a platform for decentralized, programmable group chats called spaces. Communities own their spaces on-chain, can add bots and memberships, and TOWNS is used for staking, rewards and governance.
toyota: Toyota Motor is a Japanese carmaker based in Toyota City and one of the largest in the world, founded in 1937. It builds Toyota and Lexus cars and Hino trucks and is known for its «just-in-time» production system and the Prius hybrid.
tpl: Texas Pacific Land is one of the largest private landowners in Texas, based in Dallas. It grew out of an 1888 trust created in a railroad bankruptcy and earns money from oil and gas royalties, land leases and water sales in the Permian Basin.
tpr: Tapestry is a US fashion brand holding company from New York. It owns Coach, the leather bag brand founded in 1941, as well as Kate Spade.
tpt: TokenPocket Token (TPT) is the token of TokenPocket, a multi-chain self-custody crypto wallet founded in 2018 and available on mobile, desktop and as a browser extension. TPT is used for rewards, fee discounts and community programmes in the wallet's ecosystem.
tra: Trabzonspor Fan Token (TRA) is the official fan token of Trabzonspor, the football club from the Turkish Black Sea city of Trabzon. Fans who hold it can vote in club polls, join contests and get rewards and perks linked to the team.
trac: OriginTrail (TRAC) is a project from Slovenia building a decentralized knowledge graph for artificial intelligence and supply chains. It helps verify where data and goods come from, and TRAC is used to pay for publishing and storing data on the network.
trade: Polytrade (TRADE) is the token of Polytrade, a marketplace for tokenized real-world assets that started in trade finance. Businesses' invoices and other assets are turned into on-chain investments, and TRADE is used for staking and rewards.
tradoor: Tradoor is a decentralized derivatives exchange that uses its own NDMM market-making model, designed with risk controls to protect traders, liquidity providers and the protocol from sudden market moves. TRADOOR is the platform's token.
trb: Tellor (TRB) is a decentralized oracle that delivers outside data, such as prices, to smart contracts on Ethereum and other networks. Data is submitted by participants who stake TRB, and they can lose their stake for reporting false information.
tread: Tread.fi is an algorithmic trade-execution platform for crypto traders that lets them trade on many centralized and decentralized exchanges from a single interface. TREAD is the ecosystem's token.
tree: Tree (TREE) is the utility token of Tree News, a fast crypto news service for traders. Holding the token unlocks a subscription tier with all the perks that were previously reserved for TreeNFT holders.
trent: Trent is an Indian fashion retailer from Mumbai and part of the Tata group. It runs the Westside and Zudio store chains and Star grocery stores, and operates Zara stores in India in a joint venture with Inditex.
trgp: Targa Resources is a US energy infrastructure company based in Houston. It gathers and processes natural gas, fractionates natural gas liquids and runs pipelines and export terminals for liquefied petroleum gas.
tri: Thomson Reuters is a Canadian information company from Toronto, formed in 2008 by the merger of Thomson and Reuters. It provides lawyers, accountants and tax professionals with professional databases and software (Westlaw, Checkpoint) and owns the Reuters news agency.
tri-etf: Thomson Reuters is a Canadian information company from Toronto, formed in 2008 by the merger of Thomson and Reuters. It provides lawyers, accountants and tax professionals with professional databases and software (Westlaw, Checkpoint) and owns the Reuters news agency.
tria: Tria (TRIA) is a self-custodial crypto neobank: one account combines a Visa card, swaps, perpetual futures and earn vaults across many blockchains, with its BestPath engine routing each action so users never bridge or switch networks by hand.
tribe: TRIBE is the governance token of Tribe DAO, which ran Fei Protocol, issuer of the FEI stablecoin, and after a 2021 merger also Rari Capital. Holders voted on upgrades and the DAO treasury; the DAO wound down its protocols in 2022.
trn: Terna is the operator of Italy's national high-voltage power grid, based in Rome. It owns most of the country's transmission lines, balances electricity supply and demand across Italy, and builds new interconnections, including undersea cables.
troll: TROLL is a Solana meme coin inspired by internet trolling culture and the famous Trollface meme. It was created for fun and community and has no utility or intrinsic value of its own.
trow: T. Rowe Price is a US investment management firm from Baltimore, founded in 1937. It runs mutual funds, retirement plans and portfolios for individuals and institutions and is known for active, growth-focused management.
trp: TC Energy is a Canadian energy company based in Calgary that operates one of North America's largest natural gas pipeline networks. It also owns power plants, including a stake in the Bruce nuclear station in Ontario.
true-token: True is a decentralized prediction market on the Base blockchain. Users buy and sell shares in the outcomes of real-world events in politics, sports, tech and finance, prices reflect the crowd's odds, funds stay in users' own wallets and oracles settle the results.
truf: TRUF.Network (TRUF), formerly Truflation, is a decentralized data network for economic and financial indexes. It publishes on-chain data such as real-time inflation measures that apps and smart contracts can use; TRUF pays for data and secures the network.
trump: Official Trump (TRUMP) is a meme coin on Solana, launched in January 2025 on the eve of Donald Trump's inauguration and tied to his brand. The token gives no rights to any company or income — it is purely a meme and collectible asset.
trunk: TRUNK is the stablecoin of Elephant Money, a DeFi project on BNB Chain. It aims to stay near one US dollar and is supported by the project's treasury, which holds its other token, ELEPHANT, and other assets.
trust: Intuition is a layer-2 network for trusted data: users create and vouch for claims about people, projects and things, forming an open, token-curated 'trust graph'. AI and recommendation services can use this data; TRUST is the network's token.
truth: Swarm Network (TRUTH) is a decentralized protocol in which swarms of AI agents, together with people, check facts and data and record the results of the checks on the blockchain. The TRUTH token is used for payments, staking and rewards for network participants.
trv: The Travelers Companies is one of the largest US insurers, with roots going back to 1864 and headquarters in New York. It insures business property and liability as well as cars and homes; its symbol is a red umbrella.
trx: TRON is a blockchain founded by Justin Sun in 2017. It is popular for sending stablecoins, above all USDT, thanks to low fees; TRX pays for network resources and is used for staking.
tsc: TensorCash (TSC) is a proof-of-work Layer 1 blockchain forked from Bitcoin Core in which mining means running AI inference instead of hashing. Miners answer prompts with registered open-source language models, and each answer comes with a proof that nodes can verify.
tsco: Tractor Supply is the largest rural lifestyle retail chain in the US, headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee, and founded in 1938. It sells animal feed, farm and ranch supplies, tools, clothing and equipment for farmers, homeowners and pet owners.
tsla: Tesla is an American electric car maker based in Austin, Texas, led by Elon Musk. It builds the Model 3, Model Y, Cybertruck and other cars, Powerwall and Megapack batteries for homes and the grid, and develops self-driving, robotaxis and the Optimus humanoid robot.
tsla-token: Tesla • Robinhood Token is a tokenized version of Tesla shares issued by Robinhood for its customers in the European Union. The token follows the price of the US-listed stock and lets people trade Tesla exposure around the clock on a blockchain.
tsm: TSMC (Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing) is the world's largest contract chipmaker, based in Hsinchu, Taiwan, and founded in 1987 by Morris Chang. It makes processors to order for Apple, Nvidia, AMD and other companies on the most advanced production processes.
tsm-token: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing • Robinhood Token is a tokenized version of TSMC shares issued by Robinhood for its customers in the European Union. It follows the price of the US-listed stock and can be traded around the clock on a blockchain.
tsmc: TSMC (Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company) is a Taiwanese contract chipmaker from Hsinchu, founded in 1987 by Morris Chang. As the world's largest chip foundry, it produces the most advanced processors for Apple, Nvidia, AMD and Qualcomm.
tsn: Tyson Foods is one of the world's largest meat producers, headquartered in Springdale, Arkansas, and founded in 1935. It processes chicken, beef and pork and sells food under the Tyson, Jimmy Dean, Hillshire Farm and Ball Park brands.
tst: Test (TST) is a memecoin on BNB Chain that the network's team launched on the four.meme platform as a test token for a tutorial video. Despite the plan, it became popular and now trades on exchanges as a memecoin.
tsuki: Tsuki (TSUKI) is a cat-themed meme coin on the Solana blockchain. Its name means moon in Japanese, and the project builds its community image around Japanese culture; the token has no function beyond trading and community.
tt: Trane Technologies is an Irish-domiciled climate technology company that makes heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) systems for buildings and homes. Its brands include Trane and American Standard, and Thermo King for refrigerated trucks and containers.
tt-token: ThunderCore (TT) is the coin of ThunderCore, a fast, low-fee layer-1 blockchain that is compatible with Ethereum's EVM. It focuses on everyday apps, games and DeFi, and TT pays network fees and is used for staking.
tte: TotalEnergies is a French energy company based in Paris and one of the world's largest oil and gas groups, with roots going back to 1924. It produces oil and gas, is a major LNG supplier, refines oil, runs a network of filling stations and is rapidly expanding solar and wind power.
ttwo: Take-Two Interactive is an American video game publisher based in New York, founded in 1993. It owns Rockstar Games, maker of Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption, the 2K label behind NBA 2K, Civilization and BioShock, and the mobile games company Zynga, bought in 2022.
ttwo-token: This is a tokenized version of Take-Two Interactive stock issued by Backpack, giving crypto users price exposure to the shares. Take-Two is the New York-based video game publisher behind Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption (Rockstar Games) and NBA 2K.
turbo: Turbo (TURBO) is a meme coin on Ethereum created in 2023 by artist Rhett Mankind following prompts from the GPT-4 chatbot and a budget of 69 dollars. It is promoted as the first meme coin designed by artificial intelligence; the token has no practical function.
turtle: Turtle (TURTLE) is a DeFi liquidity platform launched in 2024 that matches crypto protocols seeking liquidity with liquidity providers, curating reward campaigns and tracking deposits and rewards without taking custody of funds.
tusd: TrueUSD (TUSD) is a dollar-pegged stablecoin launched in 2018 by TrustToken and later sold to Techteryx, a company linked to the Tron ecosystem. Its reserves are meant to be held in dollars and short-term assets, with attestations published online, and it runs on Ethereum, Tron and other networks.
tut: Tutorial (TUT) is a memecoin on BNB Chain. It grew out of a developer's video tutorial on how to launch your own token on BNB Chain, and aims to promote building projects on that network.
twlo: Twilio is an American cloud company from San Francisco, founded in 2008. Its APIs let developers build SMS, voice calls, video, email and chat into their apps, for example for login codes and notifications.
twt: Trust Wallet Token (TWT) is the token of Trust Wallet, a popular mobile crypto wallet owned by Binance since 2018. TWT holders get fee discounts inside the wallet, bonuses and a vote on how the product develops.
tx: tx is a US platform for tokenized real-world assets: issuing, trading and settling tokenized stocks, ETFs and alternative assets through a network of regulated partners. KYC/AML checks are built directly into the tokens.
txn: Texas Instruments is a US semiconductor maker based in Dallas, founded in 1930. It leads in analog and embedded chips for industry and cars, is also known for school calculators, and its engineer Jack Kilby invented the integrated circuit.
tyl: Tyler Technologies is a US software company from Plano, Texas, that serves the public sector. Its software runs courts, tax and payment systems, public safety, schools and city and county administration for thousands of local governments.
uai: UnifAI Network is infrastructure for autonomous AI agents that makes DeFi simpler: agents carry out investment strategies on a user's behalf, and developers can build their own agents on the platform. UAI is the ecosystem token.
ual: United Airlines is one of the world's largest airlines, headquartered in Chicago. It has hubs in Chicago, Denver, Houston, Newark and San Francisco, flies domestic and international routes and is a founding member of Star Alliance.
ub: Unibase is a decentralized memory layer for AI agents, giving them long-term memory and the ability to work across different platforms. The project builds blockchain infrastructure for an "open agent internet"; UB is the ecosystem token.
uber: Uber is an American tech company from San Francisco, founded in 2009. Through its app people order rides with drivers, food and grocery delivery (Uber Eats) and freight transport (Uber Freight) in dozens of countries.
ubsg: UBS is Switzerland's largest bank, headquartered in Zurich and Basel. It is the world leader in managing wealth for affluent clients, and in 2023 it took over its long-time rival Credit Suisse.
ubt: Unibright is a German blockchain company that builds tools for connecting business processes to blockchains, including a visual workflow designer that works without coding. UBT is the token used across its platform and services.
ucg: UniCredit is one of Italy's largest banks, headquartered in Milan. Beyond Italy it owns major banks in Germany (HypoVereinsbank), Austria (Bank Austria) and Central and Eastern Europe, serving retail and corporate clients.
ucn: UCHAIN (UCN) is the coin of UCHAIN, a high-speed blockchain that supports smart contracts and says it can process more than 2,000 transactions per second, aimed at developers building decentralized applications.
ufd: Unicorn Fart Dust (UFD) is a meme coin on Solana, launched through the pump.fun platform in 2024. It is driven by humor and community and has no built-in utility.
ulta: Ulta Beauty is the largest beauty retailer in the US, based in Bolingbrook, Illinois, and founded in 1990. It sells cosmetics, fragrance and skin and hair care from drugstore to luxury brands, and runs beauty salons inside its stores.
ultima: Ultima (ULTIMA) is the token of the Ultima ecosystem, which runs on its own DPoS blockchain and focuses on fast, cheap everyday payments. The ecosystem includes a wallet, a payment card and other services for storing and spending the coins.
ultracemco: UltraTech Cement is India's largest cement maker and part of the Aditya Birla Group, based in Mumbai. It produces grey cement, ready-mix concrete and white cement (Birla White) at plants across India and abroad, supplying homes, infrastructure and commercial projects, and is one of the biggest cement companies in the world outside China.
uma: UMA (Universal Market Access) is a DeFi protocol for creating financial contracts and a decentralized oracle. Its "optimistic oracle" confirms real-world events and data for smart contracts, including resolving Polymarket prediction markets; the UMA token is used for voting and settling disputes.
umbra: Umbra (UMBRA) is a privacy infrastructure project on Solana that lets users send, receive and hold tokens privately, hiding balances and transaction details. Its token was launched through the MetaDAO launchpad.
umc: UMC (United Microelectronics) is a Taiwanese contract chipmaker from Hsinchu, founded in 1980 as Taiwan's first semiconductor company. It manufactures chips on mature process nodes for cars, displays, communications and consumer electronics.
umg: Universal Music Group is the world's largest music company, headquartered in Hilversum (Netherlands) and Santa Monica. Its labels such as Republic, Interscope, Island and Def Jam release Taylor Swift, Billie Eilish and The Weeknd, and it manages a huge catalog of music rights.
